schedules.topic_zh: 恐怖之声——解构《REANIMAL》的氛围音景
schedules.topic_en: The Sounds of Horror: Deconstructing the Atmospheric Soundscape of REANIMAL

speakers.title_zh: Tarsier Studios音频设计师
speakers.title_en: Audio Designer at Tarsier Studios
speakers.introduction_zh:
我在Tarsier Studios担任音频设计师已有三年。我有幸以技术音频设计师的身份参与了《Reanimal》的开发，负责音效设计、音频整合以及游戏中的技术系统。我认为自己是全能型，从音效设计到在Wwise和Unreal Engine 5中的音频整合，包括作曲，所有音频相关的工作我都有涉及（但我并非《Reanimal》的作曲师）。在加入Tarsier之前，我曾作为自由音效设计师参与多个独立游戏项目，其中最具代表性的是Studio Mantasaur的《All Hands On Deck》。在游戏行业之外，我也有担任录音和混音师的经验。

 

演讲内容摘要：

在《REANIMAL》中，音景不仅仅是恐怖氛围的陪衬——它是将玩家与这个破碎、充满氛围感的世界紧密相连的心理纽带。

作为技术音效设计师，我不仅有机会参与设计烘托孤立感、恐惧感与衰败感的音频，还将其整合进一套流畅、动态响应的音频生态系统里。

本次演讲会让听众了解构建《REANIMAL》音景所运用的创作理念与技术系统：

首先，我们先聊《REANIMAL》中的怪物。为了唤起一种诡异感、熟悉感与恐惧感，我们以现实世界为基础来设计这些怪物。我们将探讨如何对真实的、有机的动物叫声进行处理、叠加与加工，从而创造出既令人毛骨悚然、又真实可信的怪物音效，同时也会涉及部分创作理念与技术实现。

从生物层面转向机械，演讲将转向游戏中的交互式载具与机械系统——例如小船、冰淇淋车、大风扇和滚筒机。我们将探讨《REANIMAL》世界中更技术感的一面，例如我们如何设计出那些感觉破败、荒凉、且不属于任何特定时代的机械。

我们将深入剖析其背后的技术实现，探讨如何运用动态参数调制、实时物理追踪以及游戏状态，让这些载具呈现出真实可信的质感——听起来像是真实存在的，突突作响的，摇摇欲坠的破败机械。

最后，演讲将探讨环境音效世界构建这一主题，聚焦于克制与悬念的力量。在我们的游戏中，你听不到的声音往往与你听到的同样重要。我们将分析《REANIMAL》如何运用悬念与极简主义，营造出一种压抑、沉重的氛围。同时探讨我们的环境音效系统如何动态变化——以荒芜感作为结构性手段，唤起一种被遗弃的孤寂感，并与游戏中高强度、混乱的高潮场景形成对比，进一步放大冲击力。
speakers.introduction_en:
I have been working at Tarsier Studios for the past 3 years as an Audio Designer. I had the chance to work on Reanimal as a Technical Audio Designer, so I did both sound design and implementation and technical systems on the game too. I view myself as a generalist, I do everything audio related from sound design to audio implementation in Wwise and Unreal Engine 5 as well as composing (I was not a composer for Reanimal). Before working at Tarsier, I was a freelance sound designer on various indie projects, most notably Studio Mantasaur´s´All Hands On Deck´. Outside of the game industry, I have experience as a record and mixing engineer.



Abstract:


In REANIMAL, the soundscape is not just an accompaniment to horror—it is the psychological connective tissue that binds the players to our fractured, atmospheric world. As a technical sound designer, I had the opportunity to not only take part in designing the audio that aims to underline isolation, dread, and decay but to integrate it into a seamless, responsive audio ecosystem.

This presentation is intended to allow the listeners a look into the creative philosophies and technical systems used to build REANIMAL’s soundscape. First, we will take a look into REANIMAL’s monsters. To evoke a sense of uncanniness, familiarity and dread, we anchored the design of the creatures in the real world. We will discuss how raw, organic animal vocalizations were manipulated, layered, and processed to create monsters that sound eerie, yet believable and authentic. We will explore some of our creative fundaments as well as some of the technical execution too.

Moving from the biological to the mechanical, the presentation shifts to the game’s interactive vehicle and machine systems—such as the boat, the ice cream truck, the large fan, or the tumbler. We will discuss the more technological side of REANIMAL´s world, such as how we approached designing machines that feel desolate, broken and not tied to any specific time period.

We will break down the technical implementation under the hood, looking into how dynamic parameter modulation, real-time physics tracking, and game states are utilized to make these vehicles feel like believable,
sputtering, fragile machines barely holding together in the game´s hostile environment.

Finally, the presentation explores the topic of ambient world-building, focusing on the power of restraint and suspense. In our games, what you don’t hear is often just as vital as what you do. We will analyze how REANIMAL leverages suspense and minimalism to construct an oppressive, heavy atmosphere. We will look into how our ambient systems dynamically shift, using desolation as a structural tool to evoke a sense of abandonment and to contrast and amplify the game’s high-intensity, chaotic set pieces.

speakers.title_en: Director of Consulting at Newzoo
speakers.introduction_zh:
Ben Porter现领导全球领先的PC与主机游戏市场情报机构Newzoo的咨询业务，为全球顶级游戏发行商、开发商及投资机构提供市场规模评估、商业战略与资本配置建议，并将专有游戏数据转化为可执行洞察。他曾参与游戏行业多项投资与合作决策，包括上市、并购及大型IP投资的商业尽职调查。其研究涵盖品类经济学、玩家需求建模及商业化策略。Ben也是Game Developers Conference（GDC）的常邀演讲嘉宾，负责发布Newzoo年度《PC与主机游戏市场现状》报告。在加入Newzoo前，他曾在Aucerna从事八年咨询工作，为能源企业提供经济分析与投资组合优化建议。

演讲内容摘要：

Newzoo将带来最新的全球PC及主机游戏市场权威洞察，基于其独有的全球市场数据库和玩家调研成果，全面解析行业最新发展趋势。本次演讲由Newzoo咨询总监Ben Porter主讲，他将通过详实的数据分析，深入解读全球PC与主机游戏市场规模变化、平台格局演进、重点区域市场表现以及面向开发商、发行商和游戏平台的关键增长机会。

在40分钟的分享中，Ben还将结合2026年最新发布的数据，重点探讨1至2个当前最具关注度的行业热点议题，确保内容紧贴市场动态与行业实践。与会者将获得具有实际参考价值的市场洞察和趋势判断，帮助企业更好地制定商业战略、优化产品与变现规划、提升玩家运营与用户参与度，从而在快速变化的全球游戏市场中把握未来增长机遇。
speakers.introduction_en:
Ben Porter leads the consulting practice at Newzoo, the global benchmark for PC and console games market intelligence. He advises the world's largest game publishers, developers, and investors on market sizing, commercial strategy, and capital allocation, translating proprietary PC and console data into actionable insights. Porter has supported investment and partnership decisions across the games industry, including commercial due diligence for public listings, M&A, and major franchise investments. His work spans genre economics, player demand modeling, and monetization strategy for top-tier studios and platform holders globally. He is a recurring speaker at the Game Developers Conference (GDC), where he presents Newzoo's annual State of PC & Console Games report, and regularly presents to senior industry audiences globally. Prior to Newzoo, Porter spent eight years in consulting at Aucerna, advising energy companies on economic analysis and portfolio optimization.

Abstract:

Newzoo presents the definitive PC & console market update — built on exclusive global datasets and player research. Join Ben Porter, Director of Consulting, for a data-driven look at the latest market sizing, platform shifts, regional highlights, and key opportunities for developers, publishers, and platform holders. This 60-minute session will also explore 1–2 special topics based on fresh 2026 data, ensuring maximum relevance. Attendees will leave with actionable insights to inform business strategy, monetization planning, and player engagement in the year ahead.

schedules.topic_en: Short Story of Mona

speakers.title_zh: 隐藏关工作室制作人
speakers.title_en: Game Producer at Hidden Level
speakers.introduction_zh:
07年在厦门御风行做美术设计师，做《蜀山online》等项目，接着是极致游戏的艺术总监，做《道友请留步》等项目，后面兼做厦门异次元的艺术总监和厦门麻吉尔的创始人，做《元气幻灵师》和《小小朋来城》等项目。目前是新创厦门隐藏关游戏工作室。正在制作《莫娜：无尽的旅途》。

演讲内容摘要:

本次分享围绕《莫娜：无尽的旅途》展开，将完整拆解作品核心设计逻辑：首先追溯故事创作起源，梳理完整剧情脉络，解读选择黑暗幻想题材承载内核的创作初衷；其次讲解专属美术风格的打磨过程，剖析双主角设定的叙事与情感价值，说明全 3D 场景在沉浸感、空间探索上的设计优势；同时解析高操作门槛战斗系统的设计思路，阐释复杂操作与角色战力、游玩体验的适配逻辑。另外会介绍剧情融入游戏的多元呈现方式，包括主线、支线、场景彩蛋、道具叙事等融合手段，平衡叙事与玩法。最后展望作品后续内容更新、玩法优化与世界观拓展的长期规划，完整展示从故事、美术、玩法到长线运营的全套创作思考。
speakers.introduction_en:
I worked as an Art Designer at Xiamen Yufengxing in 2007, participating in projects including Shushan Online. Later, I served as Art Director at Woobest Games, where I developed titles such as Daoist, Stay A While.

After that, I took on dual roles as Art Director of Xiamen Yiciyuan and Founder of Xiamen Major-XL studio, creating games like Spirit Fantasy Master and Panland City .

Currently, I founded the newly established Xiamen Hidden Level Game Studio, and we are in production on Mona: The Endless Journey.

Abstract:

This presentation focuses on Mona: Endless Journey, fully analyzing the core design logic of the work. First, it traces the origin of the story, sorts out the complete plot, and explains why dark fantasy is chosen to carry the core theme. Next, it illustrates the polishing process of its exclusive art style, analyzes the narrative and emotional significance of the dual-protagonist setup, and clarifies the advantages of full 3D scenes in immersion and spatial exploration. It also interprets the design philosophy behind the skill-intensive combat system and how complex controls match character abilities and gameplay experience. Besides, it introduces diverse ways to integrate storytelling into gameplay, including main quests, side stories, environmental easter eggs and item texts to balance narrative and mechanics. In the end, it prospects long-term plans covering content updates, gameplay improvements and world expansion, presenting a full set of creative ideas ranging from plot, art and combat to long-term development.

speakers.introduction_zh:

姜磊在动作游戏领域有着丰富的经验和众多成功的代表作，作品遍及手机、主机、PC等各种平台，并在中美日欧等全球主流市场中获得了千万级用户的认可。2024年发布的<苍翼：混沌效应>是姜磊极具强烈个人设计表达的游戏作品，获得了电击Indie大赏2024、NYX GAME AWARDS等诸多奖项。

演讲内容摘要：

《苍翼：混沌效应/X》历经PC(Windows/MacOS)，手机（iOS、Android、HarmonyOS），主机（Nintendo Switch 1/2、PlayStation、Xbox Series X|S），一路走来不断获得了持续的销量，也获得了更高的正向影响力。这是对所有中小团队都有参考价值的案例。
speakers.introduction_en:
Jiang Lei is the CEO and game producer of 91Act, a game studio based in Chengdu, China. He has led the creation of critically acclaimed titles including BlazBlue Entropy Effect 、Crossing void 、Blzeblue RR. Prior to founding 91Act, Jiang Lei also served as a lead creator at companies such as Tencent and Shanda, where he produced games including Kung Fu Kids.

With extensive experience in the action game genre and a strong portfolio of successful titles, Jiang Lei's work spans mobile, console, and PC platforms, earning tens of millions of players across major global markets including China, the United States, Japan, and Europe. Released in 2024, BlazBlue Entropy Effect is a game that reflects Jiang Lei's distinctive personal design vision, and has received numerous accolades including the Dengeki Indie Game Awards 2024 and the NYX Game Awards.

Abstract：

BlazBlue Entropy Effect / X has made its way across PC (Windows/macOS), mobile (iOS, Android, and HarmonyOS), and console (Nintendo Switch 1/2, PlayStation, and Xbox Series X|S), steadily building both sales momentum and a growing positive reputation along the way. This is a case study with real practical value for small and mid-sized teams everywhere.

     侯明娟女士获得过多个行业和企业领导力的奖项和荣誉，包括：2026年中国美国商会授予的“杰出女性领导者奖”、新华网2024“木兰悦享荟-巾帼力量”荣誉称号、2023“福布斯中国杰出商界女性100”、《财富》中国“2021年中国最具影响力的商界女性”、《创业邦》“2020年最值得关注的女性高层管理者”和《通信世界》“2020年5G最佳实践者”等。
speakers.introduction_en:
Mingjuan Hou is the vice president of Qualcomm. In her role, she leads and manages Qualcomm’s brand strategy, corporate communications, product marketing, digital communications, and media/industry analyst relations in China, and providing communications consel to senior management.

Mingjuan has more than 20 years of rich experience in corporate communications, branding, marketing strategy, digital communications, crisis management and public affairs.Since joining Qualcomm in 2002, she led the team successfully executing multiple branding and marketing campaigns and spearheaded long-term strategic collaborations with renowned IPs such as China National Geography and the KPL. These initiatives have significantly broadened and deepened the presence of Qualcomm’s corporate brand — as well as its product brands, Snapdragon® and Qualcomm Dragonwing™ — across more diverse, consumer-relevant touchpoints, which greatly enhance their awareness and reputation  in the Chinese market. She led to establish Qualcomm’s corporate communications strategy and social media platforms in China, and helped develop co-marketing strategy with leading Chinese smart device makers, auto companies, e-commerce platforms, IoT vendors and many more. In addition, She is also a long-standing advocate for advancing women in technology. Leveraging her own career journey and Qualcomm’s best practices, she actively champions the empowerment of women and supports their continued growth, impact, and leadership across the tech industry.

Mingjuan is a recipient of a number of industry and corporate leadership awards, including AmCham China’s Outstanding Female Leader Award (2026), Xinhuanet’s Mulan Yue Xianghui Empowerment Award (2024),Forbes China’s Top 100 Businesswomen (2023), Fortune China’s Most Influential Businesswomen (2021), Cyzone’s Most Notable Businesswomen (2020) and Communications World’s Best 5G Practitioner (2020).

speakers.title_zh: 摩登天空创始人、CEO，草莓音乐节主理人
speakers.title_en: Founder & CEO of Modern Sky, Curator of Strawberry Music Festival
speakers.introduction_zh:
1997年12月创办摩登天空公司，并出版清醒乐队首张专辑《好极了！？》。现任摩登天空CEO，旗下签约艺人160余组，出版唱片600余张。

2007年开始，沈黎晖领导摩登天空先后创建和参与了多个音乐节品牌，其中草莓音乐节自2009年创办以来，已在全国多个城市巡回举办170余场，吸引了近千万乐迷的热情参与，现已成为全球瞩目的高频次音乐节品牌，也是备受当代年轻人关注的重要生活方式场景。

他还举办了多个艺术展以及跨界文化项目。摩登天空公司为中国摇滚音乐、独立音乐，以及更广义的原创音乐的发展贡献了不可或缺的力量，现已成为中国首屈一指的原创音乐厂牌及音乐节运营机构。
speakers.introduction_en:
Shen Lihui, who's the lead singer of the Sober Band（清醒乐队）, producer, also founded Modern Sky in December 1997 and then published the Sober Band's first album "Excellent!" ? "《好极了！？》. Currently he's the CEO of Modern Sky which has more than 170 signed artists and has published more than 600 albums.

Since 2007, Shen Lihui has led Modern Sky to create and participate in a number of music festival brands, including the Strawberry Music Festival has held more than 160 concerts in many cities across the country since its inception in 2009, attracting the enthusiastic participation of nearly 10 million music fans. It has now become a globally recognized high-frequency music festival brand and one of the most popular contemporary music festivals. Important lifestyle scenes that young people pay attention to.

He also held several art exhibitions and cross-border cultural projects. Modern Sky has contributed an indispensable force to the development of Chinese rock music, independent music, and a wider range of original music. Modern Sky has become China's premier original music label and music festival promoter.

台，业务版图延伸⾄电竞、⾳乐、AIGC等多元内容⽣态。

陪伴、沉浸式互动等⽅向，加速⼈⼯智能技术在数字娱乐场景的规模化落地。
加⼊趣丸之前，作为⻛险投资从业者⻓期关注互联⽹与⽂娱产业，具备丰富的战略管理、投资并
购与业务运营经验，对数字娱乐新场景的演进与商业化路径有深⼊洞察。
speakers.introduction_en:
Zhuang Minghao, Vice President and Chief Strategy Officer of Quwan Technology, oversees
group-level strategic planning, new business incubation, and ecosystem partnerships.
Quwan Technology is a well-recognized digital entertainment and social technology
company in China. Its flagship product, TT Yuyin, is one of the country's top voice-based
social platforms, with an expanding business portfolio across esports, music, and AIGC
driven content ecosystems.
Anchored in interest-based social interaction, the company is building a comprehensive
digital entertainment ecosystem while actively investing in AIGC and multimodal large
models. Its current focus spans virtual humans, AI companionship, and immersive
interaction, driving the large-scale deployment of AI technologies across digital
entertainment scenarios.
Prior to joining Quwan, he worked as a venture capital professional with a long-standing
focus on the internet and entertainment industries, bringing extensive expertise in
corporate strategy, investment, M&A, and business operations, along with deep insight into
the evolution and commercialization of next-generation digital entertainment.

speakers.title_zh: X先生沉浸游戏联合创始人、度节度列创始人
speakers.title_en: Co-founder of MR.X Immersive Games and Founder of Dujie Dulie
speakers.introduction_zh:
曹枕书创造了世界上第一个商业化的真人密室逃脱。同时也联合创始了第一个密室逃脱品牌“MR.X”。
内容经验：十年间一直引领行业颠覆性创新，曾经创作过数十个线下沉浸式作品，不乏「弥生」、「安卡拉之心」、「阴阳师」等行业现象级产品。
管理经验：管理公司近百家门店数千名员工。推动行业正规化发展，曾获得全国沉浸行业内容备案第一证。
二次创业：
2025年与触宝科技创始人兼CEO王佳梁共同创立AI密室公司——上海度节度列文化传播有限公司，目前聚焦AI密室逃脱的硬件、 IP、AI 市场营销的一站式解决方案。
speakers.introduction_en:
Cao Zhenshu created the world’s first commercial live-action escape room, and co-founded the pioneering escape room brand MR.X.

With a decade of industry experience, he has led disruptive innovations and developed dozens of immersive offline works, including blockbuster hits such as Miseong, Heart of Ankara and Onmyoji.

He has managed nearly a hundred stores and thousands of employees, promoted the standardized development of the immersive industry, and obtained the first official filing certificate for immersive works nationwide.

In 2025, he co-founded Shanghai Dujiedulie Culture Communication Co., Ltd. with Wang Jialiang, founder and CEO of TouchPal Technology, focusing on one-stop solutions for AI escape rooms covering hardware, IP and intelligent marketing.

speakers.avatar: admin/fun/1779111406852/互影科技创始人兼CEO 鹍鹏 .jpg
speakers.title_zh: 互影科技创始人兼CEO
speakers.title_en: Founder and CEO of AltStory Technology
speakers.introduction_zh: 互影科技创始人兼CEO，约翰·霍普金斯大学硕士，中国互动叙事领域先行者。他长期深耕人机交互、AI与互动叙事的融合，主导研发了面向互动叙事的底层引擎与云游戏交互技术体系，是国家级互动技术与云游戏标准的重要参与者。他推出中国首部互动剧《古董局中局之佛头起源》，制作的《飞越13号房》等多部作品列入Steam年度国产销量TOP5并入选戛纳、威尼斯等国际电影节；AI驱动的互动直播《超级狸谱表决》实现超300万用户实时参与。2025年，他发起AltNext全球互动体验创作者社区，致力于构建下一代互动创作者生态。
speakers.introduction_en: Kun Peng (Gary), Founder and CEO of AltStory Technology, holds a Master's degree from Johns Hopkins University and is a pioneer in China's interactive narrative space. With deep expertise at the intersection of human-computer interaction, AI, and interactive storytelling, he led the development of a proprietary engine for interactive narrative and a cloud-gaming-compatible interactive technology framework, and is a key contributor to China's national standards for interactive technology and cloud gaming. He produced China's first interactive drama, <Mystery of Antiques: Origin of the Buddha Head>, and his subsequent works including erta: <Breakout 13> have ranked among the Top 5 best-selling Chinese titles on Steam and been selected for the Cannes and Venice international film festivals. His AI-powered interactive live experience, Super Tanuki Vote, engaged over 3 million users in real time. In 2025, he founded AltNext, a global community for interactive experience creators dedicated to building the next-generation interactive creator ecosystem.

speakers.title_zh: OpenSpot AI CEO
speakers.title_en: CEO of OpenSpot AI
speakers.introduction_zh:
2020 全球 Under 30 空间计算设计师。1.曾任字节跳动 PICO 互动系统框架与多人互动内容平台负责人，主导空间计算场景下的互动系统与多人内容平台建设；2. 负责字节跳动飞书文档互动业务，具备从 3D 交互、多人协同到内容生产工具的跨平台产品与系统经验。

现任 OpenSpot AI CEO，致力于打造 AI 原生3D 游戏化互动内容生成平台，帮助品牌、创作者与企业快速生成可互动、可传播、可发布的下一代互动内容体验。
speakers.introduction_en:
Lucas Jianfeng Ni was named a 2020 Global Under 30 Spatial Computing Designer.

He previously served as the lead for ByteDance PICO’s Interactive System Framework and Multiplayer Interactive Content Platform, where he led the development of interactive systems and multiplayer content platforms for spatial computing scenarios. He also worked on ByteDance Lark’s document interaction business, bringing cross-platform product and system experience across 3D interaction, multiplayer collaboration, and content creation tools.

He is currently the CEO of OpenSpot AI, where he is building an AI-native 3D gamified interactive content generation platform that helps brands, creators, and enterprises rapidly create next-generation interactive content experiences that are engaging, shareable, and ready to publish.

speakers.title_en: General Manager of China Mobile Migu Interactive Entertainment Co., Ltd.
speakers.introduction_zh: 习亮，中国移动咪咕互动娱乐有限公司总经理，深耕运营商与互联网行业近二十载，长期专注数字文娱赛道发展，深度参与中国移动音乐、阅读等专业公司的筹备组建与经营运营工作，统筹推进北京冬奥会、世界杯等多项重大国际体育赛事运营落地，是中国移动数字文娱业务核心带头人之一。
speakers.introduction_en: Mr. Xi Liang, General Manager of China Mobile Migu Interactive Entertainment Co., Ltd, brings nearly two decades of cross-sector expertise in telecom and internet, with a sustained commitment to digital entertainment. He played a pivotal role in the establishment and operational management of China Mobile's music, reading, and other specialized business units. He has also spearheaded the execution of major international sports events, including the Beijing Winter Olympics and the FIFA World Cup. Recognized as a core leader in China Mobile's digital entertainment business, he brings a wealth of strategic and operational insight to the forefront of the industry.

speakers.title_zh: 百度集团副总裁
speakers.title_en: Corporate Vice President, Baidu
speakers.introduction_zh:
袁佛玉，毕业于清华大学电气工程和自动化专业。曾先后就职于宝洁、东风标致、网易公司，负责市场营销、战略研究、公众沟通、商务合作、用户增长等方面工作。

2018年7月，袁佛玉作为集团副总裁加盟百度，负责集团公司和各事业部的市场营销工作；2023年4月起先后负责百度智能云生态和渠道建设、业务运营、战略、销售及产品管理等方面工作；现负责百度智能云泛科技、金融、能源、制造等行业商业化工作。
speakers.introduction_en:
Ms. Yuan  joined Baidu in 2018 as Corporate Vice President, and oversaw the company's branding, marketing, and public communications, university partnership, and CSR. Since April 2023, Ms.Yuan has taken on responsibilities for business operations, strategy, sales and product management for Baidu AI Cloud Group. Now, Ms. Yuan oversees the commercialization efforts of Baidu AI Cloud Group across the technology, finance, energy, and manufacturing industries.

Before joining Baidu, Ms. Yuan worked for Procter & Gamble, Dongfeng Motors and NetEase.com. with years of experience leading marketing, branding, public communications, and business cooperation. Ms. Yuan is a graduate of Tsinghua University, where she received her degree in Electrical Engineering and Automation.

speakers.title_zh: 三七互娱技术中心数据副总裁
speakers.title_en: Vice President
speakers.introduction_zh: 王传鹏，三七互娱技术中心数据副总裁，毕业于北京航空航天大学计算机学院，硕士研究生。曾任职于霍尼韦尔、当当网、新浪微博等知名企业，拥有近二十年技术研发、系统架构与数据智能化实践经验。2017年加入三七互娱技术中心以来，长期致力于以技术、产品和数据能力赋能游戏产业，牵头推进集团数据智能化与AI能力体系建设，带领团队构建行业垂类大模型“小七大模型”及系列AI应用平台，形成覆盖游戏研发、发行、运营等核心环节的数智化产品矩阵，持续推动三七互娱游戏研运全链路智能化升级。
speakers.introduction_en:
Wang Chuanpeng, 37 Interactive Entertainment Vice President of Data at the Technology Center, graduated with a master's degree from the School of Computer Science at Beihang University. He previously held technical and leadership roles at Honeywell, Dangdang, and Sina Weibo, and brings nearly 20 years of experience in technology R&D, system architecture, and data intelligence.

Since joining the Technology Center of 37 Interactive Entertainment in 2017, he has focused on empowering the gaming business through technology, products, and data-driven innovation. He has led the development of the company's data intelligence and AI capability framework, overseeing the creation of the industry-focused "Xiao Qi" large language model and a suite of AI application platforms. Under his leadership, the team has built an intelligent product ecosystem spanning game development, publishing, and operations, driving end-to-end AI-powered transformation across the company's game business.

speakers.title_zh: 骏梦游戏战略商务负责人
speakers.title_en: Head of Strategic Business Development at Junmeng Games
speakers.introduction_zh: 沈独伊，现任骏梦游戏战略商务负责人，深度参与《仙境传说》（RO）IP的产品规划与对外合作。历任vivo游戏生态经理、星竞威武（NIP Group）海外商务总监、索尼（SONY）高级商务经理，在游戏渠道生态建设、IP海外拓展及主机平台IP商务合作方面积累了丰富经验。熟悉全球游戏市场格局，擅长跨国商务谈判与资源整合，长期负责骏梦游戏IP合作相关及对外商务拓展工作。
speakers.introduction_en: Shen Duyi, currently the Head of Strategic Business Development at Junmeng Games, deeply involved in product planning and external cooperation for the Ragnarok Online (RO) IP. Previously served as Game Ecosystem Manager at vivo, Overseas Business Director at NIP Group, and Senior Business Manager at Sony. Has accumulated extensive experience in game channel ecosystem development, overseas IP expansion, and console platform IP business partnerships. Familiar with the global gaming market landscape, skilled in cross-border business negotiations and resource integration. Long-term responsibilities include overseeing IP-related collaborations and external business development at Junmeng Games.

speakers.title_zh: 北京幻景数研科技有限公司联合创始人
speakers.title_en: Co-founder of Beijing Huanjing Shuyan Technology Co., Ltd.
speakers.introduction_zh:
钱清泉，北京幻景数研科技有限公司联合创始人，XR行业资深从业者。2013年起即投身虚拟现实研发，是国内最早一批VR技术探索者之一，拥有十余年XR领域全链条研发与商业化经验。多次推进线下虚拟现实模式的发展。

幻景数研是一家专注于XR大空间内容制作与运营的独立科技公司，致力于将虚拟现实与真实文旅场景深度融合。代表作《山海空间》、《仙剑奇侠传XR》是国内首部基于Apple Vision Pro的户外大空间MR内容，在2000余平方米户外空间中为60-80名用户同时提供虚实融合的沉浸式体验，也是国内首个实现规模化运营的户外MR大空间项目。2025年，公司与北京数字电视国家工程实验室合作的AStation幻景XR空间，落地广电总局超高清重点实验室，进一步验证了XR大空间在文旅场景的商业化路径。

钱清泉长期关注空间交互语言与AI技术的融合，致力于推动XR内容从“小众体验”走向“大众产品产品”。
speakers.introduction_en:
Qian Qingquan, Co-founder of Beijing Huanjing Shuyan Technology Co., Ltd., is a seasoned XR industry professional. Since 2013, he has been dedicated to virtual reality R&D, making him one of China's earliest VR pioneers. With over a decade of full-chain XR development and commercialization experience, he has repeatedly driven the evolution and deployment of location-based virtual reality models.

Huanjing Shuyan is an independent technology company specializing in XR large-space content production and operation, committed to deeply integrating virtual reality with real-world cultural tourism scenarios. Its flagship works, Shanhai Space and The Legend of Sword and Fairy XR, are among China's first outdoor large-space MR experiences built for Apple Vision Pro, delivering immersive, reality-blended experiences for 60–80 concurrent users across 2,000+ square meters of outdoor space — making them the country's first commercially scalable outdoor MR large-space projects. In 2025, the company partnered with the National Engineering Laboratory for Digital Television (Beijing) to launch the AStation XR Space, now operating at the NRTA Key Laboratory for Ultra-High-Definition TV, further validating the commercial path of XR large-space experiences in cultural tourism.

Qian is focused on the convergence of spatial interaction language and AI, driving XR content from "niche experiences" toward "mass-market products."

speakers.title_zh: FunloomAI CEO
speakers.title_en: CEO of FunloomAI
speakers.introduction_zh: 吴同，FunloomAI CEO，以AI原生游戏为驱动构建内容共创引擎，连续完成3轮数千万融资。曾任职于Unity，游戏行业持续创业5年，库兰游戏创始人，代表作《12世纪的黎凡特》《活过今晚》等十余款游戏，获得吉比特、CUSGA、电魂等游戏创作大赛最佳玩法奖，运营游戏发行自媒体‘咕咕同’获得数百万播放。曾于北京邮电大学带队研发国家重点项目故宫LBVR与数字人方向并发表SCI论文6篇。
speakers.introduction_en: Wu Tong, CEO of FunloomAI, has built a content co-creation engine driven by AI-native games and successfully completed three rounds of tens of millions of yuan in financing. He previously worked at Unity and has been continuously entrepreneurial in the gaming industry for 5 years. He is the founder of Kulan Games, with representative works including "12th Century Levant", "Survive Tonight", and over ten other games. His games have won best gameplay awards in game creation competitions such as Gibeat, CUSGA, and Dianhun. The game he operated and published on the media platform 'Gugutong' has garnered millions of views. He also led a team at Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications to develop national key projects in the direction of Forbidden City LBVR and digital humans, and published six SCI papers.

speakers.title_zh: 西班牙驻上海经济商务领事
speakers.title_en: Economic and Commercial Counsellor at the Economic and Commercial Office of Spain in Shanghai
speakers.introduction_zh:
熙沫雅女士现任西班牙驻上海经济商务领事，负责领导经济商务处，并推动西班牙在华商业利益的发展。在此职位上，她致力于支持西班牙企业的国际化进程，并努力加强西班牙与中国之间的双边贸易、投资与机构合作。

她拥有西班牙瓦伦西亚大学经济学与工商管理学位，以及比利时布鲁日欧洲学院的欧洲研究硕士学位。她同时也是西班牙国家贸易专家与经济学家团（Spanish State Corps of Trade Specialists and Economists）的成员。

在其卓越的职业生涯中，María Simó 女士专注于国际贸易、多边机构以及中小企业政策领域。她曾先后担任西班牙驻洪都拉斯、危地马拉和泰国大使馆的经济商务参赞，在促进国际商务关系及支持西班牙企业海外发展方面积累了丰富的经验。
speakers.introduction_en:
Ms. María Simó is the Economic and Commercial Counsellor of Spain in Shanghai, where she leads the Economic and Commercial Office and promotes Spanish business interests in China. In this role, she supports the internationalisation of Spanish companies and works to strengthen bilateral trade, investment and institutional cooperation between Spain and China.

She holds a Degree in Economics and Business Administration from the University of Valencia and a master’s degree in European studies from the College of Europe in Bruges, Belgium. She is also a member of the Spanish State Corps of Trade Specialists and Economists.

Throughout her distinguished career, Ms. Simó has specialised in international trade, multilateral institutions, and SME policy. She has served as Economic and Commercial Counsellor at the Embassies of Spain in Honduras, Guatemala and Thailand, gaining extensive experience in fostering international business relations and supporting Spanish companies abroad.

speakers.title_zh: 北京开心麻花演艺经纪有限公司产品中心总经理
speakers.title_en: General Manager of the Product Center at Beijing Mahua FunAge Productions & Theatres Co., Ltd.,
speakers.introduction_zh: 北京开心麻花演艺经纪有限公司产品中心总经理，负责舞台剧制作、国际版权运营、主创开发与创新业务孵化，具备丰富的戏剧制作、IP运营及跨文化合作经验，负责《贼想得到你》《窗前不止明月光》等多部话剧及音乐剧项目制作。自2019年起，带领团队开拓开心麻花沉浸式演艺产品线，打造《偷心晚宴》、沉浸版《甄嬛传》等代表性沉浸式项目，持续探索戏剧与体验融合的新模式。
speakers.introduction_en:
Hong Ye is the General Manager of the Product Center at Beijing Mahua FunAge Productions & Theatres Co., Ltd., responsible for stage production, international licensing operations, creative talent development, and innovation incubation. She has extensive experience in theatre production, IP operation, and cross-cultural collaboration, and has produced multiple stage plays and musicals, including *The Comedy About a Bank Robbery* and *Out of Order*.

 

Since 2019, she has led the development of Mahua FunAge’s immersive entertainment productions, creating representative immersive projects such as *Stealing Hearts Banquet* and the immersive adaptation of *Empresses in the Palace*, while continuously exploring new formats that integrate theatre with immersive audience experiences.

speakers.title_zh: QuestMobile  首席策略分析师
speakers.title_en: Chief Strategy Analyst, QuestMobile
speakers.introduction_zh:
拥有多年广告、咨询与品牌研究经验，聚焦大数据用户洞察、内容与流量研究及品牌营销策略分析。

擅长从用户、平台、内容与商业化视角出发，提炼行业趋势与增长机会，为品牌、互联网平台等各行业广告主提供策略分析支持。
speakers.introduction_en: With extensive experience in advertising, consulting, and brand research, I focus on big data-driven user insights, content and traffic analysis, and brand marketing strategy. By analyzing user behavior, platform dynamics, content trends, and monetization opportunities, I identify industry trends and growth opportunities to support strategic decision-making for brands and digital platforms.

speakers.title_zh: Unity 中国 AI 产研负责人
speakers.title_en: Yousandi Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. Technical Director, Unity China
speakers.introduction_zh:
Unity 中国 AI 产研负责人，拥有 10 多年云服务、游戏及 AI 领域相关经验，先后在微软、EA 等公司任职。

目前带领团队打造 Tuanjie AI——面向 Unity / 团结引擎的 AI Agent，致力于将 AI 能力深度融入引擎工作流，重塑开发者的创作方式。

此前曾负责小游戏宿主，以及 Unity 云渲染、云桌面、云编辑器等多款云产品的研发。
speakers.introduction_en: With over 10 years of relevant experience in cloud services and the gaming industry, he has previously held positions at Microsoft, EA and other enterprises. He is currently responsible for the research and development of cloud services and products for Unity China and has led his team to launch multiple cloud products including Unity Cloud Rendering, Unity Cloud Desktop and Unity Cloud Editor.

speakers.title_zh: Makers Fund 投资人
speakers.title_en: Investor, Makers Fund
speakers.introduction_zh: Yoyo Yang 现任 Makers Fund 投资人，负责亚洲地区游戏生态系统的早期及成长期投资，重点关注游戏、AI娱乐及互动内容领域。Makers Fund 是全球领先的专注游戏赛道的风险投资基金，已投资逾百家顶级游戏及技术团队，覆盖全球各国家与地区。加入 Makers Fund 前，Yoyo 曾担任日本头部游戏公司战投部门的海外投资负责人，深度参与游戏及泛娱乐赛道的跨国投资与IP全球合作。
speakers.introduction_en:
Yoyo Yang is currently an investor at Makers Fund, where she focuses on early and growth-stage investments in the gaming ecosystem across Asia, with particular attention to gaming, AI-powered entertainment, and interactive content.

Makers Fund is a leading global venture capital fund dedicated to the gaming industry, having backed more than 100 top-tier gaming and technology teams worldwide.


Prior to joining Makers, Yoyo led overseas Investments at a leading Japanese gaming company. In this role, she was deeply involved in cross-border investments and global IP partnerships across gaming and entertainment.

speakers.title_zh: 美酷瑞创始人兼首席执行官
speakers.title_en: Founder and CEO of Gamercury AI
speakers.introduction_zh:
朱笑靖，美酷瑞创始人兼CEO，拥有近20年游戏与数字内容行业经验。曾任盛大游戏副总裁、分众游戏CEO，长期负责游戏研发、发行与商业化运营。职业生涯中主导打造《热血传奇手游版》《永恒之塔》《百万亚瑟王》《新网球王子》等多款知名产品，累计管理项目总营收超过200亿元人民币，在游戏研发、发行推广及全球化运营领域拥有丰富经验。

近年来，朱笑靖专注于人工智能与游戏产业融合创新，创办Gamercury AI，带领团队研发AI世界引擎及AI原生3D游戏《神探夏洛克：暗夜追踪者》，探索AI驱动的角色人格、情绪、记忆、叙事与动态世界生成技术在数字内容领域的创新应用。公司已完成多轮融资，入选微软AI加速器全球Top20、谷歌全球创业加速器等国际创新项目，并荣获腾讯游戏大赛AI技术大奖、数龙杯最佳视觉表达奖等荣誉。
speakers.introduction_en:
Michael Zhu is the Founder and CEO of Gamercury AI, with nearly 20 years of experience in the gaming and digital content industry. He previously served as Vice President of Shanda Games and CEO of Focus Media Games, leading game development, publishing, and commercialization initiatives. Throughout his career, he has played a key role in the success of several well-known titles, including Legend of Mir Mobile, Aion, Million Arthur, and The Prince of Tennis, overseeing projects that generated more than RMB 20 billion in cumulative revenue. He possesses extensive expertise in game development, publishing, marketing, and global operations.

In recent years, Michael has focused on the convergence of artificial intelligence and interactive entertainment. He founded Gamercury AI and leads the development of the AI World Engine and the AI-native 3D game Detective Sherlock: Shadow Stalker. His work explores the application of AI-driven character personalities, emotions, memory systems, narrative generation, and dynamic world simulation in digital content creation.

Under his leadership, Gamercury AI has secured multiple rounds of investment and has been selected for prestigious international innovation programs, including the Microsoft AI Accelerator Global Top 20 and Google for Startups Accelerator. The company has also received industry recognition, including the Tencent Game Competition AI Technology Award and the Dragon Cup Best Visual Expression Award.

speakers.title_zh: 火山引擎游戏行业AI解决方案负责人
speakers.title_en: Head of AI Solutions for the Gaming Industry at Volcengine
speakers.introduction_zh: 火山引擎游戏行业AI解决方案负责人，多年的游戏行业AI应用实践的经验，对AI的infra、模型及agent在游戏行业的商业化推进有深刻的理解。
speakers.introduction_en: Wang Anheng is the Head of AI Solutions for the Gaming Industry at Volcengine. With extensive experience in the practical application of AI in gaming, Wang Anheng has a deep and insightful understanding of the commercialization strategies for AI infrastructure, models, and agents within the sector.

speakers.title_zh: TapTap制造负责人
speakers.title_en: Head of TapTap Maker at XD
speakers.introduction_zh:
姜黎 —— TapTap 制造 负责人
2020年加入心动网络（XD Inc.），目前负责 TapTap 制造。曾主导研发星火编辑器和多款 MOBA 游戏，拥有多年的游戏研发与平台运营经验。
speakers.introduction_en: Li Jiang joined XD Inc. in 2020 and currently oversees TapTap Maker. With years of experience in game development and platform operations, they previously led the R&D of the Spark Creative Editor and several MOBA games.

Mary Ma serves as the Head of AIGC Content at JD Retail Content Ecosystem. She oversees the overall strategic planning for AIGC content on the platform and core initiatives including partnerships within the online literature content ecosystem.

With in-depth experience in the AI content sector, she focuses on the implementation of AIGC technologies, innovative intelligent content marketing and commercial strategic cooperation, and continuously explores integration models between AI and retail content scenarios.

During the 2026 JD 618 Shopping Festival, she led JD 618 Cyber Gala, the world’s first AI-powered shopping live gala. The event partnered with over a hundred brands and IPs, creating an integrated live-streaming experience of watching, interacting and shopping, and set a new benchmark for AI-powered gala marketing across the industry.

speakers.introduction_en:
With 12 years of experience in brand advertising and marketing, she specializes in full-chain commercialization of film and television content. She adheres to content-driven growth, empowering brands to achieve long-term development through high-quality content.

Her business scope includes long-drama brand integration, IP licensing and omnichannel integrated marketing. She also develops customized brand short dramas, premium short drama placements, mini theaters for top short drama IPs, as well as endorsements and live-stream collaborations with short drama cast, forming a closed-loop commercial system integrating content and brands. She has delivered over a hundred customized brand short drama projects.

She has created benchmark short dramas including Westward Odyssey for TCL, Home & Family 2 for Synear, Ride the Tide and Bloom Like Fireworks for Meituan, helping brands expand audience reach, penetrate consumption scenarios, capture consumer mindsets and deliver efficient omnichannel communication.

speakers.title_zh: 沉浸科技首席执行官
speakers.title_en: CEO of Immersion Technology
speakers.introduction_zh: 作为国内沉浸式体验先行者，自2016年创立沉浸世界品牌以来，率先提出VR大空间数字化升级理念，带领团队自主研发“FREMA”标准化大空间VR平台，打造全国入驻商业体最多的行业标杆。2025年带领品牌全线升级沉浸世界MAX，以自研VISMAX科技全感技术方案为核心，推动“超级IP+极致体验“双轮驱动，构建“体验+餐饮+零售”多元场景矩阵，致力于打造下一代室内数字化超级乐园，持续引领沉浸式娱乐产业化发展。
speakers.introduction_en: As a pioneer in China’s immersive experience industry, Chen Xin founded the Immersive World brand in 2016 and was the first to propose the digital upgrade of large-format VR spaces. He led his team to develop the “FREMA” standardized large-space VR platform, establishing the industry benchmark with the largest footprint in commercial venues nationwide. In 2025, he spearheaded the brand’s full upgrade to Immersive World MAX, centered on the proprietary VISMAX full-sensory technology solution. Driving the dual-engine strategy of “Super IP + Ultimate Experience”, he has built a diversified scenario matrix integrating experiences, dining, and retail. Committed to creating the next-generation indoor digital super amusement park, he continues to lead the industrial development of immersive entertainment.

speakers.avatar: admin/fun/1783938935067/14、心影随形联合创始人兼 COO 王碧豪.jpg
speakers.title_zh: 心影随形联合创始人兼 COO
speakers.title_en: Co-founder and COO of Xinying Suixing
speakers.introduction_zh:
王碧豪，心影随形联合创始人兼 COO。团队打造的"逗逗游戏伙伴"等产品，是 AI C 端应用的领军之作，全球用户已突破千万。
拥有十年产品经理经验，曾任百度、bilibili、快手的产品总监与高级总监，操盘过上亿 DAU 业务的全面战略分析，并成功推广过多款超百万 DAU 的产品。作为 GTM 专家，主导过千万级预算投放与 AI 产品的完整发布。
过去三年全身心投入 AI 创业，累计融资过亿，用户超过 2000 万。同时是 vibe coding 与 agent 开发的重度用户，GitHub 提交逾十万次，PR 曾被知名 agent 项目采用，并独立发布过多个 agent 与 skills 项目。
speakers.introduction_en:
Bihao Wang is Co-founder and COO of Xinying Suixing. The products built by his team, including Doudou Game Companion, are leading consumer AI applications with over ten million users worldwide.
He brings ten years of product management experience, having served as Product Director and Senior Director at Baidu, bilibili, and Kuaishou. He has led full strategic analysis for businesses with hundreds of millions of DAU and successfully scaled multiple products past one million DAU. As a GTM expert, he has managed budgets in the tens of millions and driven end-to-end launches of AI products.
Over the past three years, he has devoted himself to AI entrepreneurship, raising over 100 million RMB and reaching more than 20 million users. He is also a heavy user of vibe coding and an active agent developer, with over 100,000 GitHub commits, a PR adopted by a well-known agent project, and several independent agent and skills releases.

speakers.avatar: admin/fun/1783938954267/15、奇点灵智联合创始人兼 CMO 胡琛.jpg
speakers.title_zh: 奇点灵智联合创始人兼 CMO
speakers.title_en: Co-founder & CMO, Singularity Intelligence
speakers.introduction_zh:
毕业于清华大学计算机系，资深连续创业者。曾任网易有道联合创始人、易信CEO及脉脉首席增长官，并于2010年创办知名电商平台团800与折800。他深谙品牌落地与“增长黑客”体系，曾主导有道词典、易信等国民级产品的爆发，在以数据驱动降低获客成本、拉升平台活跃度上屡创行业经典案例。

在奇点灵智，他全面主导“多奇AI伴学机器人”的全链路营销体系搭建。他通过“软硬倒置”的方法与核心妈妈群体深度共创，提前 10 个月高效验证了真实的市场需求与留存；并依托共创势能完成冷启动，凭借“激活英语开口”的差异化体验与扎实口碑稳步推开全渠道，成功打开市场局面。目前，他正与团队探索多模态 AI 硬件新范式，推动儿童陪伴硬件向“AI Agent”与“自进化机器人”演进。
speakers.introduction_en:
Hu Chen | Co-founder & CMO, Singularity Intelligence
As a seasoned serial entrepreneur and Tsinghua University computer science alumnus, Hu Chen has a proven track record of building and scaling blockbuster products. He previously co-founded NetEase Youdao, and served as CEO of Yixin and Chief Growth Officer of Maimai. In 2010, he founded the prominent group-buy navigation site Tuan800 and e-commerce coupon site Zhe800. Deeply versed in brand strategy and "growth hacking" methodologies, he has spearheaded the exponential growth of household-name apps like Youdao Dictionary and Yixin, setting industry benchmarks for leveraging data-driven strategies to slash customer acquisition costs and drive platform engagement.
At Singularity Intelligence, he spearheads the go-to-market and end-to-end marketing strategy for the "Duoki" AI companion robot. By championing a unique "software-hardware inversion" approach, he led deep co-creation initiatives with core mother communities, efficiently validating real market demand and user retention 10 months ahead of schedule. Leveraging this early momentum to drive a successful cold start, he steadily scaled omni-channel distribution and successfully captured market share by capitalizing on Duoki’s differentiated experience of unlocking spoken English and cultivating solid word-of-mouth. Currently, he and his team are exploring a new paradigm in multimodal AI hardware, driving the evolution of children’s companion devices towards "AI Agents" and "Self-evolving Robots."

speakers.title_zh: 北京卓越星空科技有限公司创始人
speakers.title_en: Founder of Beijing Excellent Star Technology Co., Ltd
speakers.introduction_zh: 胡珈皓，北京卓越星空科技有限公司创始人、智元机器人增值合伙人（VAP）。长期深耕具身智能场景落地应用，依托智元机器人搭建多模态智能体沉浸式解决方案。主导机器人IP演艺、场景落地应用、机器人话剧演艺等核心商业化项目，成功打通具身智能与文旅、数字消费场景的融合链路。专注探索具身智能嵌入日常生活的落地路径，以人机交互、沉浸式具身智能体验重构消费业态，具备丰富的科技文娱商业化运营与行业生态合作实战经验。
speakers.introduction_en: Hu Jiahao, Founder of Beijing Excellent Star Technology Co., Ltd. and Value-Added Partner (VAP) of Agibot. He has long been committed to the localized application of embodied intelligence scenarios, building immersive solutions for multimodal agents based on Agibot humanoid robots. He leads core commercial projects including robot IP performance, scenario application and robot drama performance, realizing the integrated connection between embodied intelligence, cultural tourism and digital consumption scenarios. Focusing on the in-depth implementation of embodied intelligence in daily life, he reshapes the consumer industry through human-machine interaction and immersive embodied intelligent experience, with rich practical experience in tech-entertainment commercialization and industry ecological cooperation.

speakers.introduction_zh: 酷看文化联合创始人，深耕影视内容出海行业十余年，长期专注中文影娱内容全球化出海与商业化变现。熟知海外各大平台运营生态、本土化落地及全链路发行，具备全品类内容出海落地实操经验。公司主营影视剧、电影、动漫、综艺、微短剧、AI短剧全球化发行与商业化运营，深耕全球短剧，AI内容产业布局；企业凭借扎实的出海业务实力，先后获评2023年2025年国家文化出口重点企业、2026年全国成长性文化企业30强，助力中文内容规模化出海盈利。
speakers.introduction_en: Co-founder of Kukan Culture, she has over a decade of experience in the global distribution of Chinese film and TV content, with a long-term focus on the internationalization and monetization of Chinese entertainment content. She is well-versed in overseas platform ecosystems, localization, and full-chain distribution, with hands-on experience in the global rollout of all major content categories. The company specializes in the global distribution and commercial operation of TV dramas, films, animation, variety shows, micro-dramas, and AI short dramas, with a strategic focus on global short-form content and the AI content industry. Leveraging its proven strengths in content globalization, Kukan Culture was recognized as a National Key Cultural Export Enterprise in 2023 and 2025, and named among the Top 30 National Most Promising Cultural Enterprises in 2026 — driving the large-scale, profitable overseas distribution of Chinese content.

speakers.introduction_zh: 毕业于中国人民大学美学与文化创意产业专业，拥有18年跨行业经验，先后任职于东道、中信国安及人民创意，长期深耕文化创意与终端零售领域。曾服务李宁、新东方、国安社区、故宫文具等品牌，在新零售模式、O2O运营、商业规划、空间展陈及文创产品开发方面积累了丰富实战经验。近年来聚焦跨界融合，运营“时光说·东方印象”品牌，致力于将文化内容转化为可感知、可消费的场景体验。

With 18 years of cross-industry experience, I have held positions at Dongdao, CITIC Guoan, and Renmin Creative, and have long been deeply engaged in the fields of cultural creativity and terminal retail. I have served brands including Li-Ning, New Oriental, Guoan Community, and Palace Museum Stationery, accumulating extensive practical experience in new retail models, O2O operations, commercial planning, visual merchandising, and cultural and creative product development. speakers.introduction_zh: 王中杰，阅文集团海外业务总经理。在互联网及内容行业深耕十余年，具备产品规划与海内外业务管理的丰富经验。曾任职于腾讯、美团等头部平台，历任产品专家及业务负责人，对内容、游戏等互动娱乐生态有深入的实践经验。当前专注于内容的全球化布局与AI技术在内容领域的创新应用。
speakers.introduction_en:
Wang ZhongJie is General Manager of Yuewen Global Business. He has over a decade of experience in the internet and content industries, with extensive expertise in product strategy and cross-border business management.

Prior to joining Yuewen, he worked at leading tech companies including Tencent and Meituan, where he served as a product specialist and business head. He has extensive hands-on experience in content, gaming, and the broader interactive entertainment ecosystem.

He is currently focused on the global expansion of web novel-based IP and the exploration of AI-driven innovation in web novel content creation and cross-media adaptation.

speakers.title_en: Founder of Elser
speakers.introduction_zh: 刘耕，心影次元（Elser）创始人，北京大学哲学博士，前武汉大学副教授。长期关注并深耕人工智能内容生成与互动娱乐方向，致力于通过 AI 技术降低内容创作门槛，让更多普通人能够参与创作、表达与互动。其带领团队打造了 Elser 等 AI 创作平台，聚焦 AI 音视频及互动娱乐生成，探索“AI + 娱乐 + UGC”的新型内容生态。
speakers.introduction_en:
Liu Geng is the founder of Elser, holds a PhD in Philosophy from Peking University, and is a former Associate Professor at Wuhan University.

He has long focused on and specialized in AI content generation and interactive entertainment. Dedicated to lowering the threshold of content creation with AI technology, he aims to empower more ordinary people to engage in creation, self-expression and interaction.

Under his leadership, his team has built AI creation platforms represented by Elser. Centering on AI audio, video and interactive entertainment generation, the team is exploring a new content ecosystem of AI + Entertainment + UGC.

speakers.title_zh: 广大大联合创始人
speakers.title_en: Co-Founder & Global Partner, SocialPeta
speakers.introduction_zh: Constance Gao，昵号康康，广大大联合创始人。她曾在多家互联网头部企业执掌营销与市场高管要职，积累逾十年广告与大数据领域的深厚沉淀，精通服务、运营、市场、销售全链路，铸就了从战略洞察到落地执行的完整能力。目前专注数字娱乐全球增长，尤其深耕游戏出海、短剧出海，以全球级数据驱动精准剖析创意趋势，助力品牌与创作者在碎片化高互动市场中实现营销领先突围。热爱互联网，热爱生活！
speakers.introduction_en: Constance is an internet industry veteran with 10+ years of experience in advertising and big data. Her full-stack expertise covers operations, marketing, and sales, from high-level strategy to execution. Currently driving global growth for digital entertainment (gaming & short dramas), she leverages data-driven insights to help brands break through in highly fragmented markets. Passionate about tech, passionate about life.

speakers.introduction_en: Cassie Liu currently holds the position of Director of Business Development at the DramaWave&Freereels (Top apps for Vertical Drama), with profound experience in overseas internet business and global commercial cooperation. As a world-leading AI technology company, Kunlun has continuously stepped up its layout in tracks including AIGC, overseas vertical dramas and social entertainment in recent years. Ms. Liu commits to deeply connecting the company’s state-of-the-art AI technologies and content ecosystem with diversified global market demands. She has extensive practical experience in advancing the commercialization of AI and establishing an open, win-win global ecosystem.

speakers.title_zh: AI漫剧Netshort承制生态商务负责人
speakers.title_en: Business Lead, AI Comic Series Production Ecosystem, Netshort
speakers.introduction_zh:
拥有十五年整合营销实操经验，深耕世界五百强文化产业、品牌运营及媒介管理领域；CMBS商业地产全流程操盘专家，重庆科技大学校外研究生导师、金钥匙国际联盟认证总经理。

专注搭建短剧全产业链生态体系，统筹海内外实拍短剧及多元化商务合作；整合IP版权、金牌编剧、头部爆款承制团队、自研生产工具、全渠道发行等核心资源，打造以内容为核心的短剧产业生态平台。
speakers.introduction_en:
With 15 years of hands-on integrated marketing experience, she has deep expertise in the cultural industry, brand operation and media management within Fortune 500 companies. She is a specialist in end-to-end CMBS commercial real estate operation, an external graduate advisor at Chongqing University of Science and Technology, and a General Manager certified by the Golden Key International Alliance.

She focuses on building a full-industry-chain ecosystem for short dramas, coordinating live-action short drama productions both domestically and internationally, as well as diverse business partnerships; integrates core resources—including IP copyrights, top-tier screenwriters, leading production teams behind hit series, in-house production tools, and omnichannel distribution—to create a content-centric industrial ecosystem platform for short dramas.

speakers.title_zh: 井英科技（CreativeFitting）联合创始人
speakers.title_en: Co-Founder of CreativeFitting
speakers.introduction_zh: 吴高明，井英科技（CreativeFitting）联合创始人，连续创业者，专注 Agent 驱动的产品战略与商业创新。拥有十余年全球化增长与内容平台建设经验。在井英以 AI 短剧为首个落地场景，打造 Agent 自主生产、评估、进化的内容环境与商业系统；推出全球首部跻身海外微短剧热榜的 AI 短剧《Five Brothers》。此前任美股上市公司业务合伙人，从零搭建千万 DAU 级内容平台，操盘数亿美金的海外商业化增长。
speakers.introduction_en: Gaoming Wu, co-founder of CreativeFitting, is a serial entrepreneur specializing in agent-driven product strategy and business-model innovation, with over a decade of experience in global growth and content-platform development. At CreativeFitting, he is building an AI-native content environment and business system—one in which AI agents autonomously produce and evaluate content and continuously self-evolve—with AI short dramas as the initial use case. He launched Five Brothers, the world’s first AI short drama to reach overseas top charts. Previously a Partner at a NYSE-listed company, he scaled a content platform from inception to tens of millions of daily active users and generated hundreds of millions of dollars in overseas revenue.

Throughout his career, he has forged significant IP licensing partnerships with leading Hollywood production companies and global sports organizations, overseeing the development and publishing of games based on major franchises such as Terminator, Kung Fu Panda, Shrek, How to Train Your Dragon, Total Recall, and the NBA.

speakers.title_zh: 广悦律师事务所资深高级合伙人
speakers.title_en: Principal Senior Partner, WANG JING & GH LAW FIRM
speakers.introduction_zh: 杨杰律师深耕游戏法律服务领域二十余年，长期专注于网络游戏领域刑事法律业务、数据合规、知识产权及争议解决等。执业以来，累计为超百家游戏企业提供常年法律顾问、合规运营、劳动人事及知识产权保护等全方位法律服务，代理多起游戏行业具有重大影响力的刑事案件及重大诉讼案件，赢得客户广泛认可。凭借扎实的专业能力、丰富的行业经验及对游戏产业发展的深刻理解，杨杰律师先后获得《钱伯斯》《ALB》《商法》《The Legal 500》《Asialaw》等国内外权威法律评级机构持续推荐。
speakers.introduction_en:
Mr. Jie Yang has more than 20 years of experience providing legal services to the gaming industry, with a longstanding focus on criminal legal matters, data compliance, intellectual property, and dispute resolution in the online gaming sector.

 

Throughout his career, Mr. Yang has provided comprehensive legal services to more than 100 gaming companies, including ongoing legal counsel, regulatory and operational compliance, employment and labour matters, and intellectual property protection. He has also represented clients in numerous high-profile criminal cases and major litigation matters with significant implications for the gaming industry, earning widespread recognition from his clients.

 

With his strong professional expertise, extensive industry experience, and deep understanding of the development of the gaming sector, Mr. Yang has been consistently recognised and recommended by leading domestic and international legal publications and directories, including Chambers, Asian Legal Business (ALB), China Business Law Journal, The Legal 500, and Asialaw.

, General Manager of Shanghai Fangyukong Cultural & Creative Co., Ltd.
, and MBA Practice Mentor at Shanghai Normal University Business School. speakers.title_zh: 柠萌国际总经理
speakers.title_en: General Manager, Linmon International
speakers.introduction_zh: 陆雨，任职柠萌国际总经理，负责柠萌国际业务的运营和管理，包括中文剧集海外发行及国际内容制作与发行。国际内容板块涵盖海外本地长剧与微短剧的全流程制作及发行。任职期间，推动公司与全球主流国际平台达成深度合作，发行覆盖中国港澳台、东南亚、欧美等全球多地，助力多元中国题材出海；担任泰版《三十而已・曼谷篇》总制片人，推动《三十而已》 IP 全球本土化落地；海外本土微短剧跻身美国、泰国、印尼等多国流媒体榜单前列，诞生多部爆款作品。加入柠萌前，曾任WME Asia(William Morris Endeavor Asia)亚洲区资深总监，也曾效力于Lagardere Unlimited，主导美国、欧洲及中国地区的演艺经纪、体育经纪与品牌营销业务。
speakers.introduction_en:
Roy Lu

General Manager, Linmon International
Responsible for global content distribution and international operations, including full-cycle development, production, and distribution of Chinese and local-language long-form series and vertical short dramas across international markets.
Deeply rooted in the global media landscape, Roy has built robust partnerships with leading global platforms during his tenure. The distribution footprint spans Chinese Hong Kong, Chinese Macao, Chinese Taiwan, Southeast Asia, Europe, the Americas and other regions worldwide, bringing diverse Chinese narratives to a global audience. As producer of The Thirsty Thirty, he has driven the global localization rollout of the hit IP Nothing But Thirty. Additionally, under his leadership, Linmon International’s localized short-form dramas have consistently topped streaming charts in the US, Thailand, and Indonesia, solidifying its reputation for creating high-impact global hits.
Prior to Linmon, Roy served as Senior Director, Greater China at WME Asia (William Morris Endeavor), overseeing talent representation, sports management, and entertainment marketing across the U.S., Europe, and China. He worked out of WME’s Beverly Hills and Shanghai offices.

赵优秀，听花岛总制片人，制作/经纪业务负责人。曾获2025第四届金蜘蛛盛典年度微短剧制作人、2025综艺报年度盛典年度先锋制片人、2026 CEIS金河豚盛典年度微短剧制作人、2026微短剧品质盛典品质先锋制作人等荣誉。

听花岛打造了《家里家外》系列、《十八岁太奶奶驾到，重整家族荣耀》系列、《我在八零年代当后妈》等五十多部超10亿播放量的精品短剧。

Zhao Youxiu serves as Chief Producer and Head of Production & Talent Management at Heard Island. He has been honored with multiple industry awards, including the 2025 4th Golden Spider Awards Annual Short Drama Producer, 2025 Variety News Annual Awards Pioneer Producer of the Year, 2026 CEIS Golden Puffer Awards Annual Short Drama Producer, and 2026 Premium Short Drama Ceremony Pioneer Producer for Outstanding Production Quality.

Tinghua Island has produced more than fifty high-quality short dramas with individual view counts exceeding one billion, such as the Family Inside and Out series, Great-Grandma Comes at Eighteen to Restore Family Glory series and Being a Stepmother in the 1980s.

speakers.introduction_en: Liu Nandou, Editor-in-Chief of DuMore, has been deeply engaged in cultural and entertainment industry analysis for many years, has produced over 400 high-quality in-depth articles and more than 10 viral industry pieces, with research spanning major tracks of the sector including games, films, short videos and streaming media. He continuously tracks industry dynamics and maintains long-term partnerships with leading enterprises, and has co-hosted events such as the DuMore Cultural and Entertainment Conference, Weibo Influencers' Tea Party, China International Music Industry Conference and themed workshops of the Beijing International Film Festival .

speakers.title_zh: CD PROJEKT RED游戏副总监
speakers.title_en: Associate Game Director at CD PROJEKT RED
speakers.introduction_zh:
Paweł Sasko 最开始在独立游戏项目中积累经验，2009 年加入 Reality Pump Studios。在那里，他以任务设计师和编剧的身份参与了《Two Worlds II》（2010）的开发，随后在其资料片《Pirates of the Flying Fortress》（2011）中担任首席任务设计师。

2012 年，他加入 CD PROJEKT RED，以任务设计师的身份参与完成了《The Witcher 2: Assassins of Kings》的收尾工作。此后，他为《The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt》（2015）设计了大量任务，其中包括广受好评的"血腥男爵"故事线，并在两部资料片《Hearts of Stone》（2015）和《Blood and Wine》（2016）中担任首席任务设计师。

《The Witcher 3》之后，Sasko 出任《Cyberpunk 2077》（2020）首席任务设计师，全面负责游戏分支任务的设计与架构。在资料片《Phantom Liberty》（2023）中，他升任为任务总监，带领任务设计、过场动画设计和开放世界设计三个团队。

目前，Sasko 同时担任《巫师 4》和《赛博朋克 2》的游戏副总监，并参与成立 CD PROJEKT RED 的波士顿工作室。他长期通过采访、公开演讲和社区互动，分享自己在叙事、任务设计和 RPG 开发方面的心得。

 

演讲内容摘要：

伟大的游戏世界，不是靠一份世界观文档堆出来的，而是在开发过程中无数个决策积累起来的结果。每一条街区的边界、每一个汽车品牌、每一块广告牌、每一首歌谣，都是一个设计选择——它要么在强化这个世界想传达的核心气质，要么在悄悄消解它。本次演讲将拆解 CD PROJEKT RED 是如何打造出 RPG 史上两个最令人难忘的世界的——《The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt》与《Cyberpunk 2077》——以及其他开发者可以从中借鉴什么。

Sasko 将基于他在《The Witcher 3》及其两部资料片《Hearts of Stone》《Blood and Wine》、《Cyberpunk 2077》以及《Phantom Liberty》上的亲身制作经验，带大家逐层拆解世界构建的十个维度——从先于任何地图和美术资产存在的底层哲学，一路推进到"连贯性"这个终极问题：如何确保每一个像素都在朝着同一个方向使劲。

演讲将拆解三个具体的设计手法：用建筑风格建立派系识别系统；用装备和品牌设计让道具承载社会身份信息；以及用载具品牌体系在零对白的情况下完成阶级叙事——这三套方法共同回答了一个问题：如何让玩家不靠剧情、只靠眼睛，就能读懂这个世界的权力结构。还有在《Cyberpunk 2077》如何设计一套多势力关系体系——荒坂、军用科技、康陶之间的利益冲突与势力消长，如何在不打断游戏流程的前提下，让玩家自己拼出一段"发生在主线之外"的世界历史。演讲最后探讨：广告牌、媒体和时装系统如何承担世界观的输出功能，以及游戏中那些刻意留白的道德争议，为何能让玩家社群在游戏发售多年后依然讨论不止。

演讲最后想说的核心只有一句话：好的世界构建，不是让每条设定对得上，而是让每个角落感觉像同一个世界。世界里的每一个元素，无论是Toussaint的童话轮廓还是Dogtown的破败腐朽，都必须持续兑现同一个承诺 – 那个世界在第一天就刻进玩家心里的感受。
speakers.introduction_en:
Paweł Sasko began his career working on independent game projects before joining Reality Pump Studios in 2009. There, he worked as a Quest Designer and writer on Two Worlds II (2010) and later became Lead Quest Designer on its expansion, Pirates of the Flying Fortress (2011).

In 2012, he joined CD PROJEKT RED as a Quest Designer, helping complete development of The Witcher 2: Assassins of Kings. He went on to design numerous quests for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt (2015), including the acclaimed Bloody Baron storyline, and served as Lead Quest Designer on both expansions, Hearts of Stone (2015) and Blood and Wine (2016).

Following The Witcher 3, Sasko became Lead Quest Designer on Cyberpunk 2077 (2020), overseeing the creation and structure of the game's branching missions. He later served as Quest Director on the Phantom Liberty expansion (2023), leading the Quest Design, Cinematic Design, and Open World Design teams.

Today, Sasko is Associate Game Director on The Witcher 4 and Cyberpunk 2, while also helping establish CD PROJEKT RED's Boston hub. He regularly shares insights on storytelling, quest design, and RPG development through interviews, public talks, and community engagement.

Abstract：

Great game worlds are not built from lore documents, but out of many decisions made during development. Every district boundary, every vehicle brand, every billboard and bard song is a design choice that either reinforces the world's thesis or quietly undermines it. This talk breaks down how CD PROJEKT RED built two of the most beloved worlds in RPG history, The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt and Cyberpunk 2077, and what other developers can take from that craft.

Drawing on direct production experience across The Witcher 3, its expansions Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine, Cyberpunk 2077, and Phantom Liberty, the talk walks through ten layers of worldbuilding, from the foundational philosophy that precedes any map or asset, all the way to the question of coherence: how you make sure every pixel is pulling in the same direction.

The talk covers how Night City's districts and The Witcher 3's regions encode power structures spatially before a single line of dialogue. It examines how architectural styles function as faction grammar, how brands and gear turn inventory into identity, and how vehicle manufacturers in Cyberpunk 2077 map an entire social system without any traditional storytelling, like cutscenes. It looks at the corporation web of Cyberpunk 2077 and how relationships between Arasaka, Militech, Kang Tao and others make the world feel like history is happening just off screen. It covers advertising, media, fashion and the moral fault lines that make communities debate Witcher 3 and Cyberpunk 2077 for years after release.

The central argument is simple. Worldbuilding coherence is not consistency of facts. It is consistency of feeling. Every element of a world, from Toussaint's fairy tale silhouette to Phantom Liberty's Dogtown decay, must reinforce the same promise the world made on day one.

speakers.title_en: Marketing Director of Marvel Rivals at NetEase Games
speakers.introduction_zh: Yachen，网易《漫威争锋》营销负责人，曾受邀出席GDC2026（2026年全球游戏开发者大会）分享游戏市场发行与长线运营经验。 其主导发行的《漫威争锋》上线后迅速风靡全球，注册用户快速突破4000万，其Discord平台以400万以上用户规模长期占据全球最大的游戏社区，并曾多次登顶Steam全球畅销榜及热玩榜。 她深耕游戏全球发行领域十余年，曾主导多款IP游戏产品的全球增长战略，成功推动产品在全球市场的影响力扩张，在跨平台发行与运营方面具有扎实的实战经验。
speakers.introduction_en: Yachen, Marketing Director of Marvel Rivals at NetEase Games, was invited to speak at GDC 2026 (Game Developers Conference 2026), sharing her expertise in game publishing and long-term live operations. Under her leadership, Marvel Rivals quickly took the global gaming market by storm after launch, with registered users rapidly surpassing 40 million. Its Discord community, boasting over 4 million members, has consistently remained the largest gaming community on the platform. The title has also topped both the Steam Global Top Sellers and Most Played charts on multiple occasions. With over a decade of experience in global game publishing, she has led global growth strategies for multiple IP-based games, successfully expanding their reach and influence across international markets. She brings solid, hands-on expertise in cross-platform publishing and operations.

speakers.introduction_en:
Yang Yaodong, Boya Young Fellow & Research Fellow at the Institute for Artificial Intelligence, Peking University. He serves as Director of Beijing Zhiyuan Large Model Safety Center and Chief Scientist of the PKU-Lingchu Intelligence Joint Lab.

A certified High-Level Overseas Talent, he won the NSFC Excellent Young Scientists Fund (Overseas) and was selected into CAST Young Elite Scientists Sponsorship Program. His research centers on agent interactive learning and AI alignment, targeting trustworthy, safe real-world deployment of large models, spanning reinforcement learning, AI alignment and embodied intelligence.

speakers.title_zh: NEON AURELIUS创始人
speakers.title_en: Co-founders at NEON AURELIUS
speakers.introduction_zh:
Charlene Putney 是一位屡获殊荣的游戏编剧与写作老师。在Google和Facebook担任管理职位后，她自2013年起深耕游戏叙事创作领域，参与撰写了《神界：原罪2》《博德之门3》《NUTS》及《盐海编年史Saltsea Chronicles》等多部作品。她曾在都柏林三一学院、都柏林理工学院、哥本哈根IT大学、哥本哈根建筑设计学院等高校讲授游戏写作课程，并活跃于众多游戏会议与活动中——甚至曾受邀在欧洲核子研究中心（CERN）为量子科学家们讲解互动叙事！

 

演讲内容摘要：

在27年的独立游戏开发生涯中，Martin 和 Charlene 共完成了19款商业游戏，积累了大量将创意转化为成品的经验。本次演讲将探讨一个核心话题：许多游戏创意在全球范围内彼此相连，同时又深深扎根于设计者自身的文化背景之中。

 

在开发新作——策略卡牌游戏Sparrow Warfare的过程中，Martin 和 Charlene 深入研究了策略游戏的发展历史：从远古棋盘游戏，到17世纪的奥地利纸牌游戏，再到麻将，以及如今的卡牌构筑游戏。他们由此发现，许多来自早期游戏的机制在现代卡牌游戏中仍有大量未被探索的空间——而现代卡牌游戏往往只聚焦于那一套大家熟悉的固定系统。

 

他们还发现，世界各地的策略游戏之间存在着千丝万缕的联系，仿佛构成了一张跨越时空、不断演化与变异的全球创意之网。对于一家在中国演讲的丹麦工作室而言，这一发现恰恰揭示了一种微妙的平衡——超本地化设计（汲取个人与文化的独特影响）与超全球化设计（借鉴那些跨越数百年与数大洲流传下来的游戏创意）之间的平衡，而这种平衡正是触达最广泛受众的关键所在。

 

在本次演讲中，他们将分享两人共同的创作过程，并为游戏开发者提供三个可直接应用于自身项目的思路：如何发现被忽视的游戏机制、如何将个人文化影响转化为设计灵感，以及如何运用混搭文化创作出新鲜且引人入胜的作品。
speakers.introduction_en:
Charlene Putney is an award-winning games writer and teacher. After working at Google and Facebook in management positions, she’s been writing for video games since 2013, including writing for Divinity: Original Sin 2, Baldur’s Gate 3, NUTS, and Saltsea Chronicles. She has taught writing for games at Trinity College, DIT, ITU Copenhagen, KADK Copenhagen, and many conferences and events (including teaching quantum scientists at CERN about interactive fiction!).

 

Abstract：

In their 27 years of indie game development across 19 commercial releases, Martin and Charlene have learned a lot about turning game ideas into finished works. This talk is a reflection on how many ideas behind games are globally connected, while rooted in the culture their designers come from.

 

While working on their new game, strategic deckbuilder Sparrow Warfare, Martin and Charlene explored the history of strategy games: from ancient board games to 17th-century Austrian card games, mahjong, and today’s deckbuilders. From this, they realised how many mechanics from older games remain largely unexplored in modern deckbuilders, which often focus on a narrow set of familiar systems.

 

They also discovered how many strategy games from around the world are connected as if through a global web of evolving ideas and mutations. For a Danish studio presenting in China, this highlights the balance between designing hyper-locally (drawing on personal and cultural influences), and designing hyper-globally (building on game ideas that have travelled across centuries and continents) to resonate with the widest audience possible.

 

In this talk, they will share their collective creative process, and offer three ideas for game developers to apply in their own projects: how to find overlooked mechanics, how to transform personal influences into design ideas, and how to use remix culture to create fresh and engaging work.

schedules.topic_zh: 音游的下一张谱，是整个游戏——SyncArc的节奏游戏路径选择与《节奏旅社》实践
schedules.topic_en: The Next Rhythm-Game Chart Is the Game Itself” — SyncArc’s Strategic Approach to Rhythm Games and the Development of Rhythm Hotel

speakers.title_zh: 灵弧工作室创始人/制作人
speakers.title_en: Founder/producer at SyncArc Studio
speakers.introduction_zh:
拥有近20年游戏行业经验，历任腾讯XR业务线孵化负责人、搜狐畅游高级制作人、趣奇互娱创始人兼CEO，主导及参与产品累计流水超10亿元。曾打造《Lethe》《梦想养成计划》等产品，并获苹果、Google全球推荐及多项国际奖项。现创办SyncArc工作室，专注于以音乐、叙事与创新交互，为玩家创造更具情绪价值与长期生命力的游戏体验。工作室首款产品《节奏旅社》将于今年Q4发售，平台包含Steam、Swtich1/2、ios、android

演讲内容摘要：

音乐节奏游戏的创新，只能发生在谱面和输入方式上吗？作为一家专注节奏领域11年的工作室，SyncArc将从《Lethe》到《节奏旅社》的实践出发，梳理音乐节奏游戏的几种差异化路径，并复盘我们如何从视觉提示与输入融合，转向“听觉引导游戏行为”。在《节奏旅社》中，声音不只告诉玩家何时操作，也开始组织角色、场景、叙事与反馈。我们想讨论的，是当谱面不再只写给玩家的手，整个游戏将如何成为下一张谱。
speakers.introduction_en:
With nearly 20 years of experience in the game industry, I have served as Head of XR Incubation at Tencent, Senior Producer at Changyou, and Founder and CEO of Quqi Interactive. The titles I have led or contributed to have generated over RMB 1 billion in cumulative revenue. I have worked on games including Lethe and Dance Center, which received global featuring from Apple and Google, as well as multiple international awards.

I am now the founder of SyncArc Studio, where we focus on combining music, storytelling, and innovative interaction to create emotionally engaging games with long-term appeal. Our debut title, Rhythm Hotel, is scheduled for release in Q4 this year on Steam, Nintendo Switch and Switch 2, iOS, and Android.

Abstract：

Is innovation in rhythm games limited to note charts and control schemes? Drawing on 11 years of experience in the genre, SyncArc will trace several paths toward differentiation through its work from Lethe to Rhythm Hotel, while examining how our design approach evolved from integrating visual cues with player input to using sound to guide player behavior.

In Rhythm Hotel, sound does more than tell players when to act—it also begins to structure the characters, environments, narrative, and feedback. What we want to explore is this: when a chart is no longer written only for the player’s hands, how can the entire game become the next chart?

schedules.topic_zh: 从武侠世界到世界武侠——燕云十六声出海实践
schedules.topic_en: From a Wuxia World to Global Wuxia — The Overseas Launch Practice of Where Winds Meet

speakers.title_zh: 网易（杭州）网络有限公司高级营销总监
speakers.title_en: Head of Where Winds Meet Publishing at NetEase Games
speakers.introduction_zh:
10年游戏发行经验，覆盖mmo、slg、竞技、休闲、开放世界多个品类赛道，现任网易游戏高级市场总监，水滴事业部发行负责人。

演讲内容摘要：

本次演讲以《燕云十六声》出海实践为例，分享武侠开放世界的全球化本地化解决方案。

针对武侠文化晦涩、跨端开放世界海外难留存、海外玩家不信任免费游戏三大行业痛点，产品坚持“守本土文脉、做全球适配”思路落地全球化。端内，通过历史考据还原、保留东方文化内核并简化认知门槛；将抽象武侠文化转化为趣味玩法，以双线模式适配全球玩家偏好；端外，以 【免费高品质武侠】差异化发行定位，搭建海内外双向生态传播链路，搭配全域传播事件打造全球玩家共通记忆，为国风题材全球化提供可复用实践范式。
speakers.introduction_en:
With 10 years of game publishing experience spanning multiple genres including MMO, SLG, competitive, casual and open-world titles. Currently serving as Senior Marketing Director of NetEase Games and Publishing Lead of Where Winds Meet.

Abstract：

This speech shares global localization solutions for open-world wuxia games, based on the overseas launch of Where Winds Meet.

Three core industry challenges are tackled: obscure wuxia culture, low cross-platform open-world retention overseas, and overseas players’ distrust of free-to-play titles.

In-game: We restore authentic historical scenes via multi-dimensional research, retaining oriental cultural essence while lowering cultural comprehension barriers for global players. Abstract wuxia elements are turned into engaging interactive gameplay, supported by dual single/multi-player modes to fit global social preferences.

Out-of-game global outreach: We differentiate ourselves as "high-quality free-to-play wuxia", build a two-way content ecosystem linking domestic and overseas communities, and roll out cross-regional global campaigns to create shared memories for worldwide players. This delivers a replicable model for global expansion of Chinese-style games.

schedules.topic_zh: 轻量级神经网络原理在游戏中的應用及案例分析
schedules.topic_en: Light Weight Neural Network for Mobile Game and Case Study

speakers.title_zh: 华为技术有限公司图形性能功耗副首席专家
speakers.title_en: Associate Chief Expert of Graphics and Power Consumption at  Huawei Tech. Investment Co., Limited
speakers.introduction_zh:
連冠榮拥有近二十八年游戏引擎自主研发经验。

现任华为图形性能功耗副首席专家。

曾任腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司有限公司，主任工程師（T13）。

渲染引擎技术专家, 负责光子工作室, 生态发展部, 魔方工作室的前沿渲染技术。

曾任深圳市创梦天地科技有限公司游戏开发技术总监，带领《梦幻花园》《水果忍者》《神庙逃亡》《地铁跑酷》《愤怒的小鸟》等国民级手游技术团队。

曾任美国哥维拉系统顾问公司游戏引擎总工程师，带领国外工程师团队，开发主机引擎, XBOX，PS3，PS4，Wii，PSP，Android，IOS。

为国外多家著名游戏发行商及开发商（Disney，THQ，Majesco）制作主机及手游（e.g. Hannah Montana–the Music Jam）。

曾任香港理工大学／多媒体创新中心游戏技术研究员，负责实时Path Tracing，GPU图像算法研究、离散物理模拟引擎算法研究。

演讲内容摘要：

在实时手机游戏中部署神经网络面临着严格的延迟、内存和能耗限制。本主题将介绍几种有效的架构范式，这些范式通过不同的效率策略来应对这一挑战。除标准的逐层量化（PTQ）、量化感知训练（QAT）和剪枝技术外，我们还可探索更多适用于GPU推理的优化方法。

演讲者将分享总结过往游戏行业的经验，结合近年来的学术研究成果，采用重参数化多分支训练方法，并在推理阶段使用更简单的结构以减少计算开销。此外，我们将探讨用于神经网络近似的高效缓存技术，该技术支持多维函数的推理。进一步拓展这一思路，我们将引入多层缓存机制，通过分层索引的方式突破单层缓存对感受野的限制问题，从而在保持计算效率的同时提升近似精度。

我们还将展示一些关于手机实时渲染的案例研究，这些案例清晰阐释了上述技术如何协同运作，共同实现高质量的游戏图形渲染。具体而言，通过在推理阶段采用结构重参数化压缩网络，在运行时利用对GPU友好的多层缓存加速技术，最终能够在主流移动硬件上实现稳定的高帧率输出，同时保持出色的图像细节和低功耗表现。这些方法为资源受限环境下的实时图形应用提供了切实可行的技术路径。
speakers.introduction_en:
Mac Lin with nearly 28 years of independent R & D experience in game engine.

He is now the Associate Chief Expert of Graphics and Power Performance of Huawei Hong Kong Research Center.

He was an Expert Engineer (T13) and rendering engine technology expert in Tencent (Shenzhen) Ltd.

He was the Technical director of game development of iDreamSky (Shenzhen) Technology   Ltd., and led the Technical teams such as GardenScape, Fruit Ninja, Temple Run, Subway Surfer, Angry Birds, etc.

He was also the Chief Engineer of game engine of American consulting company, leading the team of foreign engineers to develop Console Engine, Xbox, PS3, PS4, Wii, PSP, Android, IOS. He has produced e.g. Hannah Montana – the music jam for many famous foreign game publishers and developers (Disney, THQ, Majesco).

He was also a Research Fellow of Game technology, Hong Kong Polytechnic University / Multimedia Innovation Center, responsible for real-time path tracking, GPU image algorithm research, discrete physics simulation engine algorithm research.

 

Abstract：

Deploying neural networks in real-time mobile games faces stringent constraints on latency, memory, and power consumption. This topic will introduce several effective architectural paradigms that address this challenge through different efficiency strategies. In addition to standard post-training quantization (PTQ), quantization-aware training (QAT), and pruning techniques, we can explore more optimization methods suitable for GPU inference.

The speaker will share experiences summarized from the past in the gaming industry, integrate recently published academic research findings, and discuss re-parameterization with multi-branch training, employing a simpler structure during the inference phase to reduce computational overhead. Additionally, we will explore efficient caching techniques for neural network approximation, which support inference of multidimensional functions. Extending this approach further, we will introduce a multi-layer caching mechanism that overcomes the limitations of single-layer caching on the receptive field through hierarchical indexing, thereby enhancing approximation accuracy while maintaining computational efficiency.

We will also present several case studies on real-time rendering for mobile phones, which clearly illustrate how the aforementioned technologies work in synergy to achieve high-quality game graphics rendering. Specifically, by employing structural re-parameterized compression networks during the inference phase and utilizing GPU-friendly multi-layer caching at runtime, it is ultimately possible to achieve stable high frame rate output on mainstream mobile hardware while maintaining excellent image detail and low power consumption. These methods provide a practical technological pathway for real-time graphics applications in resource-constrained environments.

schedules.topic_zh: 当创作效率不再是瓶颈，想象力将是唯一的门槛

speakers.title_zh: VAST创始人兼 CEO
speakers.title_en: Founder and CEO of Tripo AI
speakers.introduction_zh: 宋亚宸毕业于Johns Hopkins University，在 AI 研究、产品开发以及数字内容行业拥有丰富经验。在创立 VAST 之前，他曾于商汤科技负责 AIGC 技术在动画与游戏领域的商业化落地，随后参与了通用大模型公司 MiniMax 的早期创立工作。其横跨 AI、游戏与内容创作领域的复合背景，也促成了 VAST 对实用型、生产级 3D 工具的持续探索，致力于打造真正适用于创作者实际工作流的 AI Native 互动内容平台。
speakers.introduction_en: Simon Song (Yachen Song) is the Founder and CEO of Tripo AI. As a graduate of Johns Hopkins University, he brings experience across AI research, product development, and digital content industries. Prior to founding Tripo AI, Song led the commercialization of AIGC technologies at SenseTime, focusing on animation and gaming applications, and later participated in the early founding of MiniMax, a general-purpose large-model company. His background at the intersection of AI, gaming, and content creation informs Tripo AI’s focus on practical, production-oriented 3D tools designed for real creative workflows.

金色世纪公司（猫片传媒）  创始人、执行董事

万维猫动画公司  创始人、执行董事；

龙的天空网站创始人之一；

起点中文网核心团队成员；

原阅文集团CEO助理，资深主编；

原起点中文网及创世中文网总经理；

中国最资深IP策划人，运营专家；

创造出中国独有的影视、动画、游戏、周边与海外等全版权运作与投资的机制和经营理念——

speakers.introduction_en:
Chen Min

Founder & Executive Director of Golden Century Company (Maopian Media);

Founder & Executive Director of Wonder Cat Animation;

Founder & Executive Director of Star Interactive Technology.

He is one of the earliest pioneers and founding figures of Chinese online literature,

Co-founder of Dragon Sky Website,

Core team member of Qidian Chinese Network,

Former CEO Assistant and Senior Editor of China Literature Group,

Former General Manager of Qidian Chinese Network and Chuangshi Chinese Network.

As one of China’s most senior IP planners and operation specialists,

he created China’s unique institutional mechanism and business philosophy for full copyright operation and investment, covering film & television, animation, games, peripheral derivatives and overseas copyright licensing.

In recent years, he has successfully operated a number of globally influential and high-market-value classic IP franchises, including:

Candle in the Tomb, A Record of a Mortal’s Journey to Immortality, Infinite Horror, Perfect World, Ever Night, Joy of Life, Back to the Ming Dynasty to Be a Prince, , and many other blockbuster series with tremendous influence and commercial value both in China and globally.

He is currently the most influential individual with the richest successful case track records in China’s IP operation and investment industry.

schedules.topic_zh: Arm 神经图形技术实践：面向新一代游戏开发的 AI 驱动渲染
schedules.topic_en: Arm Neural graphics in practice - AI powered rendering for next-gen game development

speakers.title_zh: 安谋科技（中国）有限公司高级技术产品经理
speakers.title_en: enior Software Technology Manager at Arm Technology (China) Co., Ltd.
speakers.introduction_zh:
在科技与半导体领域拥有超过 20 年的深厚积累，长期专注于前沿技术的产品化与生态构建。目前, Willen 负责推动Arm AI 技术在中国开发者生态的战略落地与规模化发展。作为 Arm 新一代神经图形技术在国内的产品负责人，Willen 以前瞻性的技术视角和产业洞察，聚焦端侧AI与图形计算的深度融合，持续推动游戏体验的范式升级，致力于将媲美PC级的沉浸式视觉与性能体验带入移动终端，重塑下一代移动游戏生态。

演讲内容摘要：

游戏开发正迈入一个由 AI 渲染与神经技术引领的全新时代，这些技术正在重新定义视觉效果与性能表现。本次演讲重点介绍 了Arm 神经图形技术和开发者工具包，该工具包包含了基于神经渲染能力下的超分、插帧和降噪的实现，使开发者能够在移动设备上实现近乎媲美桌面级的画质，同时兼顾功耗与续航。

此外，还将深入解析《光影新生》手游背后的渲染管线，该款游戏由 Arm 与 Sumo Digital 联合开发，展示了在移动端硬件上实现的全光线追踪照明效果。我们将展示如何通过先进的管线工程优化与 Arm 神经图形技术相结合，在移动端实现实时性能，包括神经超分、神经降噪以及神经帧率提升等关键技术。这些创新也共同印证了将高端 AI 渲染体验引入新一代手游的可行路径。
speakers.introduction_en:
Willen has over 20 years of deep experience in the technology and semiconductor industries, with a long-standing focus on the productization of cutting-edge technologies and the development of ecosystems. Currently, he is responsible for driving the strategic implementation and large-scale growth of Arm AI technologies within the developer ecosystem in China.

As the product lead for Arm’s next-generation neural graphics technologies in China, Willen leverages a forward-looking technical vision and strong industry insight to focus on the deep integration of on-device AI and graphics computing. He continuously advances paradigm shifts in gaming experiences, striving to bring PC-grade immersive visuals and performance to mobile devices, and to reshape the next generation of the mobile gaming ecosystem.

Abstract：

Game development is entering a new era driven by AI-powered rendering and neural techniques that redefine both visual fidelity and performance. This presentation introduces Arm’s Neural Graphics Development Kit, which integrates neural-based rendering, denoising, and super-resolution to enable near–desktop-quality graphics on mobile devices while maintaining efficient power consumption.
In the second part, we provide a deep dive into the rendering pipeline behind Arm Neural Dawn, Arm’s first fully playable, production-scale mobile game created in close collaboration with Sumo Digital. We will be showcasing fully ray-traced lighting on mobile hardware and highlighting how real-time performance is achieved through a combination of advanced pipeline engineering and Arm’s neural graphics technologies, including neural super-resolution, neural denoising, and neural frame-rate upscaling. Together, these innovations demonstrate a practical path toward bringing high-end, AI-driven rendering experiences to next-generation mobile games.

speakers.title_en: Staff Software Engineer at Arm Technology (China) Co., Ltd.
