He combines technical understanding with commercial and ecosystem-focused thinking to create practical, value-driven initiatives that support industry growth and strengthen DMCC’s role within the regional and global gaming landscape

Abstract:

HyperCent is a content-driven game studio focused on the global PC and console market. Our strength lies in identifying emerging trends early and turning them into successful games through rapid execution. As a young and agile team, we specialize in discovering opportunities that resonate with players and bringing them to market quickly.

Our team, primarily made up of developers in their twenties, stays closely connected to global gaming trends, streamer culture, internet memes, and evolving genre preferences. Rather than stopping at ideas, we transform them into fully playable games and deliver them to players at a fast pace.

At HyperCent, execution is our highest priority. We strive to identify high-potential game concepts as early as possible and bring them to life with speed and efficiency. We believe mistakes should be acknowledged quickly, learned from, and improved upon rather than hidden. Clear, logical communication is a core principle of how we solve problems and collaborate. We also embrace challenges with confidence, even in areas where we lack prior experience, believing that boldness and a willingness to learn are essential to innovation.

Our commitment to rapid execution is not simply about moving fast—it is about maintaining a high level of quality while developing efficiently. Our flagship titles, Backroom Company and Backroom Cleaners, are both full 3D multiplayer PC games, projects that are considered highly ambitious for an independent studio.

In less than two years since our founding, HyperCent has already released two PC games on Steam. Beyond commercial performance, we are proud to have established meaningful brand recognition within the indie game industry and continue to build our reputation among players worldwide.

schedules.topic_zh: 从中法合作到全球化协同：游戏音频价值重构
schedules.topic_en: From China-France Collaboration to Global Co-Creation: Reframing the Value of Game Audio

speakers.title_zh: 盟岸知声创始人
speakers.title_en: Founder\CEO at Moon Audio
speakers.introduction_zh:
我是一位深耕游戏音频领域十余年的声音设计师、游戏音频监制，也是 MoonAudio 盟岸知声的创始人与负责人。在创办MoonAudio前，曾任职与腾讯、网易等游戏公司参与游戏音频设计与开发，积累了对大型项目流程、版本迭代和跨部门协作的理解。创立 MoonAudio 后，我带领团队服务多款中国及海外游戏项目，工作涵盖音效设计、音乐制作、拟音实录、声音资产制作、音频风格定义与交付管理，并持续参与中国多款头部二次元，风格化游戏及内容型项目的声音设计工作。如今，MoonAudio 正通过与 Light Fader等国际团队合作，探索更成熟的全球化音频协同管线与方式，使声音创作更好服务于项目特性、文化表达与玩家体验。

演讲内容摘要：

本次分享以 Light Fader 与 MoonAudio 的中法合作为出发点，探讨游戏音频在全球化开发语境中的价值重构。面对 AI 与创作工具带来的效率变化，音频价值不应停留在更快生成与更多交付，而应回到声音设计、审美判断与玩家体验本身。全球化协同不只是采购海外资源，而是在理解不同创作团队能力边界的基础上，根据项目目标、内容特质与文化背景，重新组织、分配与整合声音内容、协作流程和交付方式，使音频创作始终服务于更统一、更贴合项目特性，且更能触达玩家感受的游戏表达中。

我们相信，国际合作是一种重要的艺术力量。不同文化背景的创作者能带来新的创意视角、艺术参考、制作方法与叙事方式，这种多样性会在创意与技术层面创造真正的附加价值，并帮助项目为全球玩家构建更丰富、更具沉浸感的游戏体验。
speakers.introduction_en:
I am a sound designer and game audio supervisor with over a decade of deep experience in the game audio field, and also the founder and head of MoonAudio (Meng'an Zhisheng). Before founding MoonAudio, I participated in game audio design and development at companies such as Tencent and NetEase, gaining insight into large-scale project workflows, version iteration, and cross-departmental collaboration. After establishing MoonAudio, I have led my team in serving numerous Chinese and overseas game projects, with work covering sound effect design, music production, foley recording, sound asset creation, audio style definition, and delivery management. I have also been continuously involved in sound design for many of China's top-tier anime-style games, stylized games, and content-driven projects. Today, MoonAudio is collaborating with international teams such as Light Fader to explore more mature global audio collaboration pipelines and methods, enabling sound creation to better serve project characteristics, cultural expression, and player experience.

 

Abstract：

This presentation takes the Sino-French collaboration between Light Fader and MoonAudio as a starting point to explore the value reconstruction of game audio within the context of globalized development. Facing the efficiency changes brought by AI and creative tools, the value of audio should no longer be measured by faster generation or greater output volume, but should return to sound design, aesthetic judgment, and player experience itself. Global collaboration is not simply about sourcing overseas resources; rather, it involves understanding the capability boundaries of different creative teams, and based on project goals, content characteristics, and cultural backgrounds, reorganizing, allocating, and integrating sound content, workflows, and delivery methods. This ensures that audio creation always serves a game expression that is more unified, more tailored to the project, and more capable of resonating with players.

We believe that international collaboration is an important artistic force. Creators from different cultural backgrounds bring new creative perspectives, artistic references, production methods, and narrative approaches. This diversity creates genuine added value on both creative and technical levels, and helps projects build richer, more immersive gaming experiences for players around the world.

speakers.title_zh: Light Fader创始人/CEO
speakers.title_en: Owner/CEO at Light Fader
speakers.introduction_zh:
我是一位在娱乐行业拥有20年经验的法国音频总监兼制作人，专注于电子游戏领域，涵盖配音、音乐制作和声音设计。

作为 Light Fader 的创始人，我与欧洲、北美及亚洲的独立工作室和国际大型制作项目均有合作。我的工作范围包括配音指导、选角监督、配音制作、音乐制作、声音设计、剪辑、整合与最终混音。

过去几年中，我参与了许多电子游戏项目，包括《仁王3》、《光与影：33号远征队》、《刺客信条：奥德赛》、《刺客信条：幻景》、《刺客信条：英灵殿》、《天国：拯救2》、《幽灵行动：断点》、《波斯王子：失落的王冠》以及《太空飞船》。在创立 Light Fader 之前，我也曾就职于育碧，在那里积累了大型AAA级游戏制作流程及国际协作的宝贵经验。

我的日常工作需要协调来自法国、英国、北美和亚洲的多语言团队，包括演员、作曲家、声音设计师及制作伙伴。我经常在伦敦监督录音环节，并与日本和中国的合作伙伴共同推进国际制作项目。同时，我也会在部分项目中亲自参与声音设计。

除了技术层面的制作，我非常重视艺术指导与表演质量，尤其在电子游戏配音方面。我的目标始终是打造具有沉浸感和情感冲击力的音频体验，以增强游戏玩法与叙事表现。

如今，Light Fader 持续拓展国际业务，参与从独立游戏到AAA级制作的各种项目，同时与全球各大工作室和发行商建立紧密的合作关系。

我们相信，国际合作是一种重要的艺术力量。不同文化背景的创作者能带来新的创意视角、艺术参考、制作方法与叙事方式，这种多样性会在创意与技术层面创造真正的附加价值，并帮助项目为全球玩家构建更丰富、更具沉浸感的游戏体验。
speakers.introduction_en:
I am a French audio director and producer with 20 years of experience in the entertainment industry, specializing in video games, including dubbing, music production, and sound design.

As the founder of Light Fader, I work with both independent studios and major international productions across Europe, North America, and Asia. My work covers voice direction, casting

supervision, dubbing production, music production, sound design, editing, implementation, and ﬁnal mixing.

Over the past few years, I have contributed to a wide range of video game projects, including *Nioh 3*, *Clair Obscur: Expedition 33*, *Assassin’s Creed Odyssey*, *Assassin’s Creed Mirage*, *Assassin’s Creed Valhalla*, *Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2*, *Ghost Recon Breakpoint*, *Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown*, and *SpaceCraft*. Before founding Light Fader, I also worked at Ubisoft, where I gained valuable experience with large-scale AAA production pipelines and international collaboration.

My work regularly involves coordinating multilingual teams of actors, composers, sound designers, and production partners between France, the United Kingdom, North America, and Asia. I frequently supervise recording sessions in London and collaborate with partners in Japan and China on international productions. I also personally contribute to sound design on selected projects.

Beyond technical production, I place strong importance on artistic direction and performance quality, especially in video game voice acting. My goal is always to create immersive and emotionally engaging audio experiences that support gameplay and storytelling.

Today, Light Fader continues to expand internationally, working on projects ranging from indie games to AAA productions while developing strong collaborations with studios and publishers worldwide.

Lirui is the Investment Principal at Transcend Fund, a leading gaming VC. speakers.introduction_en:
Jiang Lei is the CEO and game producer of 91Act, a game studio based in Chengdu, China. He has led the creation of critically acclaimed titles including BlazBlue Entropy Effect 、Crossing void 、Blzeblue RR. Prior to founding 91Act, Jiang Lei also served as a lead creator at companies such as Tencent and Shanda, where he produced games including Kung Fu Kids.

With extensive experience in the action game genre and a strong portfolio of successful titles, Jiang Lei's work spans mobile, console, and PC platforms, earning tens of millions of players across major global markets including China, the United States, Japan, and Europe. Released in 2024, BlazBlue Entropy Effect is a game that reflects Jiang Lei's distinctive personal design vision, and has received numerous accolades including the Dengeki Indie Game Awards 2024 and the NYX Game Awards.

speakers.title_en: Founder and Producer, Singer Pictures
speakers.introduction_zh:
刘慈欣IP《纤维》《全频带阻塞干扰》制片人、XR电影《地球大炮》监制。
歌者影业致力于刘慈欣作品的影视化，歌者文旅致力于开发刘慈欣主题游乐。
speakers.introduction_en: Pan Zhouyou is the founder of GeZhe Films & Cultural Tourism. As a producer, he has championed the cinematic adaptations of Liu Cixin’s sci-fi masterworks, with credits including <Fiber> and <Full-Spectrum Barrage Jamming>, as well as serving as executive producer for the XR film <Cannonball>. Pan dedicates his expertise to bringing Liu Cixin’s literary worlds to the screen, and expands these iconic IPs into immersive, themed physical attractions.

speakers.title_zh: 导演、编剧，互动影游制作人
speakers.title_en: Director, Screenwriter, and Interactive Film and Game Producer
speakers.introduction_zh: 电影《爆水管》导演、编剧；电影《流浪地球2》C组导演、海外制片人；电影《我和我的祖国》执行导演；电影《疯狂的外星人》执行制片人等。目前正在制作一部深度应用AI技术的互动影游作品。

speakers.title_zh: 制作总监，动画制片人
speakers.title_en: Production Director and Animation Producer
speakers.introduction_zh:
资深影视视效制片人与制作总监，拥有16年影视制作与项目管理经验，深耕本土与好莱坞电影、剧集全流程制作，在垂直领域探索AI嵌入传统制作的框架。曾任职于DNEG London、Pixomondo等国际视效公司，参与《碟中谍5》《星际迷航：超越》《神奇动物在哪里》《饥饿的游戏》等好莱坞大片制作。回国后担任《长津湖》《长津湖水门桥》《蛟龙行动》《紧急救援》、《大风吹》等重磅影片的视效总监或执行制片人。
现为中国电影美术学会理事，独立运营行业公众号CGView十二年，参与编写《中国电影数字制作规范》，并主持《The Filmmaker's Guide to Visual Effects》第二版中文版翻译工作。2025年任第78届戛纳国际电影节AI科幻短片导师，同时担任VR科幻童话《烧火工》制片人及动画工作室制片人。
speakers.introduction_en:
Francine Gao is a veteran visual effects producer and production supervisor with 16 years of experience across Chinese and Hollywood film and television production, actively exploring frameworks for integrating AI into traditional filmmaking pipelines. She began her career at leading international VFX studios including DNEG (London) and Pixomondo, contributing to blockbusters such as Mission: Impossible – Rogue Nation, Star Trek Beyond, Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them, and The Hunger Games.
Since returning to China, Francine has served as VFX Supervisor or Line Producer on major titles including The Battle at Lake Changjin I & II, Operation Hadal, The Rescue, and Trapped. She currently serves as Board Director of China Film Art Direction Academy (CFADA)
For over 11 years, Francine has independently operated CGView, an industry platform publishing case studies and production standards articles. She co-authored the China Film Digital Production Standards and is leading the Chinese translation of The Filmmaker's Guide to Visual Effects (2nd Edition). In 2025, she served as AI Sci-Fi Short Film Mentor at the 78th Cannes Film Festival, and also served as the producer of the VR science fiction fairy tale "The FireKeeper” and the animation studio producer.

schedules.topic_zh: Team NINJA之道：打造硬核动作RPG
schedules.topic_en: The Way of Team NINJA: Creating Hardcore Action RPGs

speakers.title_zh: KOEI TECMO GAMES 仁王3 制作人
speakers.title_en: Nioh 3 Producer at KOEI TECMO GAMES
speakers.introduction_zh:
KOEI TECMO GAMES Team NINJA部门第1开发小组的部门经理。1998年加入Tecmo（现KOEI TECMO GAMES）。此后历任《零》系列游戏设计师、《死或生5》项目经理，一直参与《仁王》系列的制作工作。现任《仁王2 完整版》制作人、《忍者龙剑传4》开发制作人、《仁王3》制作人。

演讲内容摘要：

Team NINJA是一支日本游戏开发团队，以开发包括《忍者龙剑传》系列在内的多款动作游戏而享誉业界。近年来，我们也在探索《仁王》和《卧龙》这样的超高难度硬核动作RPG领域。在这场分享中，两位制作人会分别详细讲解各自作品的开发理念和设计原则、作品的诞生背景、开发过程中重点突出的设计要素，以及团队对制作的执着追求。通过这次分享，我们希望能把Team NINJA的开发理念和挑战传递给每位与会者。
speakers.introduction_en:
Department Manager of the Team NINJA Department 1 development team at KOEI TECMO GAMES. He joined Tecmo (currently KOEI TECMO GAMES) in 1998. Since then, after serving as a game designer for the Fatal Frame series and project manager for DEAD OR ALIVE 5, he has been involved in the production of the Nioh series. He serves as the Producer for Nioh 2 Complete Edition, Development Producer for NINJA GAIDEN 4, and Producer for Nioh 3.

Abstract：

Team NINJA is a Japan-based game development team that has earned high acclaim for developing a variety of action games, including the NINJA GAIDEN series. In recent years, we have also tackled highly difficult hardcore action RPGs such as Nioh and Wo Long. For each of these titles, the respective producer will explain in detail the philosophies and design principles under which these titles were developed, the background of how each title was born, the specific points emphasized during development, and each team's strong dedication to production. Through this session, we hope to convey Team NINJA's philosophy and challenges to every attendee.

KOEI TECMO GAMES Team NINJA部门第2开发小组的部门经理。2012年加入KOEI TECMO GAMES。此后担任《忍者龙剑传》和《死或生》系列游戏设计师、《最终幻想：纷争》系列战斗设计负责人，一直参与《卧龙》系列的制作工作。现任《卧龙：苍天陨落》导演、《忍者龙剑传4》导演、《卧龙2：凤火连天》制作人。

schedules.topic_zh: AI 赋能游戏内 UGC 创作：从专业生产到全民创作
schedules.topic_en: TBD

speakers.title_zh: 网易伏羲AI Lab视觉计算负责人
speakers.title_en: Head of Visual Computing Group at NetEase Fuxi AI Lab
speakers.introduction_zh:
李林橙，网易伏羲AI Lab视觉计算负责人，副研究员，浙江大学校外导师。聚焦游戏内三维感知、三维生成、三维重建、情感计算等图形图像算法的研究与应用，在SIGGRAPH、TVCG、CVPR、ICCV等顶级期刊与会议上发表论文50余篇，作为项目负责人主持杭州市重大科技创新项目一项，曾获浙江省科技进步一等奖，ICCV2021、CVPR2024、ECCV2024三届国际人脸表情挑战赛冠军。相关研究成果应用于《逆水寒》、《永劫无间》、《倩女幽魂》等多款知名游戏产品。

演讲内容摘要：

3D AIGC 技术正在重塑游戏内容的创作方式：形象生成、角色驱动、道具与场景编辑等能力日趋智能，大幅降低创作门槛，让个性化 UGC 内容的创作变得轻松可及。随着游戏内剧组模式等创新玩法的兴起，AIGC 正推动游戏内容从专业生产走向全民创作，让每位玩家都能成为自己故事的导演。本次分享将系统介绍网易伏羲在 3D AIGC 领域的研究脉络与算法进展：从个性化的角色形象生成，到让角色自然表演、生动演绎的智能驱动，再到面向剧情创作的道具与素材生成，覆盖短剧创作的完整链路；并探讨如何借助 AI 让虚拟角色"活"起来，让普通玩家也能自如调度角色、讲述自己的故事。最后，展示这些成果在网易头部游戏中的规模化落地实践。
speakers.introduction_en:
Li Lincheng is Head of Visual Computing Group at NetEase Fuxi AI Lab, Associate Researcher, and External Mentor at Zhejiang University. His work centers on computer graphics and computer vision algorithms for game-oriented scenarios, including 3D perception, 3D generation, 3D reconstruction, and affective computing. He has authored 50+ papers in top venues such as SIGGRAPH, TVCG, CVPR, and ICCV. He leads a Hangzhou Major Sci-Tech Innovation Project as principal investigator, He was awarded the First Prize of the Zhejiang Provincial Science and Technology Progress Award, and won three consecutive international facial expression challenges at ICCV 2021, CVPR 2024, and ECCV 2024. His research has been deployed accross multiple flagship NetEase titles, such as "Justice Online", "Naraka: Bladepoint", and "Ghost Story", among others.

Abstract:

3D AIGC technology is reshaping how game content is created. Capabilities such as avatar generation, character animation, and prop & scene editing are becoming increasingly intelligent, dramatically lowering the barrier to creation and making personalized UGC content effortless and accessible. With the rise of innovative gameplay modes like in-game "film crew" systems, AIGC is driving game content creation from professional production toward creation for all — empowering every player to become the director of their own story.

This talk provides a systematic overview of NetEase Fuxi's research trajectory and algorithmic advances in 3D AIGC: from personalized character avatar generation, to intelligent motion driving that enables characters to perform naturally and expressively, to prop and asset generation for narrative creation — covering the complete pipeline for short-form video production within games. We will also explore how AI brings virtual characters to "life," enabling everyday players to freely orchestrate characters and tell their own stories. Finally, we will showcase the large-scale deployment of these achievements across NetEase's flagship titles.

schedules.topic_zh: 聚势而生——与开发者共绘全球休闲游戏增长新曲线

speakers.title_zh: AdSurge海外拓展和并购负责人
speakers.title_en: Head of Global BD and M&A at AdSurge
speakers.introduction_zh:
Raymond Min，现任AdSurge海外拓展和并购负责人，全面负责海外业务的商业化增长、战略合作伙伴拓展及行业并购；在海外业务增长、adtech战略投资并购、AI技术生态方面拥有丰富实战经验，对全球程序化广告行业趋势和全球化战略有深刻理解。

此前，他曾就职腾讯战略部、谷歌亚太区、麦肯锡等龙头企业，负责广告平台AI战略、全球化业务增长等工作，长期获得杰出业绩评价。

Raymond拥有连续创业与产品复合背景，早年在美国创立人工智能移动应用公司并任CEO，所创产品获评苹果App Store「最佳新应用」。他毕业于康奈尔大学和清华大学，取得硕士学位。

演讲内容摘要：

全球休闲游戏进入新一轮增长周期。本次分享从市场机会、行业实践、协同赋能三个维度展开,基于AdSurge一手调研数据,为出海开发者提供可落地的增量路径。

数据层面:新兴品类年增长60%,年轻用户加速涌入,新老玩家双轮驱动增量格局。产品层面:拆解头部产品的行为数据与产品形态四阶段演进路径,提炼情感驱动获客、深度化系统、混合变现三类可复用的产品打法。品牌与市场层面:复盘游戏大厂全球化"三次进化"的核心方法论,以跨界联名为例,拆解品牌资产转化为用户增长的路径;同时梳理海外买量格局、重点市场布局,以及越南等新兴供给枢纽的崛起逻辑。

AdSurge是面向全球开发者和广告主的广告平台,为出海企业提供专业、高效、透明的广告服务。我们以持续迭代的AI技术为核心引擎,聚合全球优质流量,与开发者和广告主共同实现可持续、可盈利的增长。
speakers.introduction_en:
Raymond Min currently serves as Head of Global BD and M&A at AdSurge, where he leads the commercial growth of the overseas business, strategic partnership development, and industry M&A. He brings extensive hands-on experience in overseas business growth, ad-tech strategic investment and M&A, and AI technology ecosystems, together with a deep understanding of global programmatic advertising trends and globalization strategy.

Previously, Raymond held roles at leading organizations including Tencent's Strategy Department, Google APAC, and McKinsey & Company, where he led work spanning advertising-platform AI strategy and global business growth, consistently earning outstanding performance recognition.

Raymond has a diverse background as a serial entrepreneur and product leader. In his early career, he founded and served as CEO of an AI-powered mobile application company in the United States, whose product was recognized as a "Best New App" by the Apple App Store. He holds MBA degrees from Cornell University and Tsinghua University.

schedules.topic_zh: 多平台发行：独立游戏未来的标配
schedules.topic_en: Multi-Platform Launches: A Must Have For The Future Of Indie Games

speakers.title_zh: Top Hat Studios总裁/合伙人，发行
speakers.title_en: President / Partner, Publishing at Top Hat Studios
speakers.introduction_zh:
在游戏行业摸爬滚打十余年，我将 Top Hat Studios 从最初的一家小型联合开发与移植工作室，打造成了一家成功的全球独立游戏发行商，推出了诸如《废都电锯姬》（MOTORSLICE）、《冥界清道夫》（Crypt Custodian）和《魔王的迷宫》（Labyrinth of The Demon King）等全球热销作品。此外，我还在行业内提供咨询服务，合作对象包括 Atari，以及全球畅销的AA级游戏《The Forever Winter》。现在，我继续运营 Top Hat Studios，同时担任投资基金 DENMU 的投资与发行合伙人。

 

演讲内容摘要：

过去几年，独立游戏市场的饱和度和竞争激烈程度都在不断上升。Steam 仍然是全球主导平台，但游戏的平均收入却在持续下降，只有一小部分游戏能在该平台上获得高额营收。游戏如何被玩家发现，依然是一个巨大的挑战，而且 PC 游戏的推广难度也随着时间的推移变得越来越大。

相比之下，主机市场长期以来被视为一个完全不同的市场，而且由于物流和技术上的双重挑战，很难进入。许多工作室和发行商都错误地低估了主机的价值，只把 Steam 作为唯一的重要平台。不过，steam这条路一直在走，主机市场每年也在不断壮大，所以触及主机玩家群体就变得越来越重要了。虽然上架主机在技术上更具挑战，但相比 Steam，主机市场的竞争并不那么激烈，而且还拥有独特的推广生态——包括特定的媒体、KOL以及平台合作。主机前期的技术投入，会被长期的稳定收入以及仅限 PC 平台所没有的多元化变现方式所抵消。通过分析具体案例可以看到，采用多平台策略的发行商，表现往往远超那些只专注于单一平台的游戏。
speakers.introduction_en:
Starting in the game industry over a decade ago, I’ve grown Top Hat Studios, originally a small co-development & porting studio, into a successful global indie publisher with global hits such as MOTORSLICE (废都电锯姬), Crypt Custodian (冥界清道夫), and Labyrinth of The Demon King (魔王的迷宫). I have also done consulting around the industry, including for Atari and the AA global top seller “The Forever Winter”. I now continue to run Top Hat Studios while also being an investment & publishing partner for the investment fund DENMU.

 

Abstract：

Over the past few years, the market for indie games has become increasingly saturated and competitive. Steam continues to dominate as a global platform, but the average game continues to make less money, with only a small cohort of games making top revenue on the platform. Discoverability remains a huge challenge, and also marketing for PC games has become more difficult over time. By comparison, the console market has largely been seen as distinct and hard to enter due to both logistical and technical challenges. Many studios and publishers alike incorrectly discount consoles as a meaningful platform to only focus on Steam. However, as Steam continues along its current trajectory and consoles continue to grow each year as a market, it is increasingly important that the console playerbase is reached. Consoles, while more difficult to ship on, represent a less saturated market than Steam who also represent a distinct sector of marketing through an ecosystem of specific media, influencers/KOLs, and platform partnerships. Technical challenges upfront on consoles are counter-balanced by substantial long-term revenue and alternative methods of monetization not available to games only on PC. By breaking down specific examples, we can see how publishers focused on multi-platform strategy often far outperform games with a single platform focus.

schedules.topic_zh: 《潜水员戴夫》- 上线三年回顾
schedules.topic_en: Dave the Diver - Reflections on 3 Years Since Launch

speakers.title_zh: Mintrocket 总监/首席执行官
speakers.title_en: Director / CEO at Mintrocket
speakers.introduction_zh:
Jaeho Hwang 是 MINTROCKET 旗下《潜水员戴夫》（Dave the Diver）的游戏总监。从2017年他的首款像素风手机动作游戏《邪恶工厂》（Evil Factory），到2023年大获成功的《潜水员戴夫》，他始终致力于打造独具特色、令人回味的游戏作品。他对亚文化的深厚热情也促使他在2019年开发了《哥斯拉：防卫军》（Godzilla Defense Force）。

 

演讲内容摘要：

自发布以来，《Dave the Diver》收获了来自全球玩家的热烈反响，并持续超越最初的预期，不断成长壮大。在本次分享中，团队将回顾游戏过去三年的发展历程——从最初上线、玩家社区的反应，到多款DLC及联动内容的诞生。

本次演讲将探讨玩家反馈、团队内部的创作动力以及各种意想不到的机遇，如何共同影响并塑造了游戏上线后的内容方向。同时也将分享在通过新玩法体验、跨界联动、平台拓展以及长期运营不断扩充IP过程中所遭遇的挑战与收获的经验教训。

通过这次回顾，我们想传递实用的经验见解——一个小而独特的IP，是如何在保持原有个性与魅力的同时，逐步成长为经久不衰的全球IP系列。
speakers.introduction_en:
Jaeho Hwang is the Game Director of Dave the Diver at MINTROCKET. He has left his mark on games of unique and fulfilling quality, from his first pixel art mobile action game, <Evil Factory>, in 2017 to one of the biggest hits of 2023, <Dave the Diver>. His profound passion for subculture also led him to create <Godzilla Defense Force> in 2019.

Abstract：

Since its launch, Dave the Diver has received an incredible response from players around the world and has continued to grow far beyond its original expectations. In this session, the team will look back on the game’s journey over the past three years - from its initial launch and community reception to the creation of multiple DLCs and collaborations.

The talk will explore how player feedback, internal creative motivations, and unexpected opportunities shaped the direction of post-launch content. It will also cover the challenges and lessons learned while continuously expanding the IP through new gameplay experiences, crossover collaborations, platform expansions, and long-term live operations.

Through this retrospective, the session aims to share practical insights into how a small but unique IP evolved into a long-lasting global franchise while maintaining its original identity and charm.

schedules.topic_zh: 平衡自我与市场：如何触达市场而非追逐市场
schedules.topic_en: Aligning Ego and Market: How to Reach the Market Without Chasing It

speakers.title_zh: 合同会社Awesomes 创始人/创意总监
speakers.title_en: Founder / Creative Director at Awesomes
speakers.introduction_zh:
在游戏行业积累了五年专业经验后，我创立了 Awesomes LLC，目前正主导开发一款名为《TONIN: 兎忍》的3D动作游戏。该作将传统日本美学与科幻元素融为一体。

作为项目负责人，我统筹游戏设计、程序开发及整体制作方向等核心领域，同时与小型团队及外部合作伙伴协作推进项目。这一架构有助于实现灵活的决策机制与高效的生产流程，对中小规模团队而言尤为关键。

此外，我通过众筹平台 Kickstarter 成功筹得约1200万日元，项目已在海外玩家群体中引发广泛关注。这段经历也让我在沟通、市场营销策略及社区运营方面积累了更深厚的实战经验。

我的目标是打造兼具情感共鸣与扎实玩法的游戏作品，为玩家带来即时的感官体验与更深层的主题思考。通过这一项目，我希望证明小型团队同样能够开发出高品质、具备全球竞争力的动作游戏。

 

演讲内容摘要：

在游戏开发中，创作者常常被告知必须在"做自己热爱的游戏"和"做市场畅销的游戏"之间做出选择。本次演讲将挑战这一假设，探讨个人创作愿景与市场成功并非对立关系，而是可以相互契合的。

基于我开发《TONIN: 兎忍》并通过众筹平台 Kickstarter 成功筹得约1200万日元的经历，我将分享如何通过专注于自己对"乐趣"的理解，意外地与全球玩家产生共鸣。在开发过程中，我刻意避开了传统的商业驱动决策模式，没有针对特定市场细分人群。这让我得以充分表达创作意图，不受趋势、数据指标或外部期待的束缚。

有趣的是,这种做法并未导致产品过于小众，反而吸引了海外玩家的强烈支持，其中包括许多我最初未曾预料到的受众群体。这段经历让我意识到，差异化并非追逐当下流行趋势，而是创造真正引人入胜、能与玩家建立深层连接的作品。

在本次分享中，我将探讨如何在坚持个人愿景的同时保持对外部反馈的开放态度，从而形成可持续的开发方式。我还将分享实用经验：说明小型团队如何在不被市场趋势主导的前提下，同时实现创作真实性与全球影响力。

归根结底，本次演讲将呈现一种视角:"自我"与"市场"可以作为两根互补的支柱，帮助开发者创造既有意义又广受认可的游戏作品。
speakers.introduction_en:
After gaining five years of professional experience in the game industry, I founded Awesomes LLC and am currently leading the development of TONIN: 兎忍, a 3D action game that blends traditional Japanese aesthetics with science fiction elements.

As the project lead, I oversee core areas of development including game design, programming, and overall production direction, while collaborating with a small team and external partners. This structure enables flexible decision-making and efficient production, which are essential for small to mid-sized teams.

In addition, I successfully raised approximately 12 million yen through Kickstarter, a crowdfunding platform, and the project has already attracted strong interest from players overseas. Through this experience, I have further developed my expertise in international communication, marketing strategy, and community building.

My goal is to create games that combine emotionally engaging storytelling with compelling gameplay, delivering both immediate excitement and deeper thematic experiences. Through this project, I aim to demonstrate that small teams can deliver high-quality, globally competitive action games.

Abstract：

In game development, creators are often told to choose between making what they love and making what sells. This talk challenges that assumption by exploring how personal creative vision and market success are not opposing forces, but can be aligned.

Based on my experience developing TONIN: 兎忍 and raising approximately 12 million yen through Kickstarter, a crowdfunding platform, I will share how focusing on my own sense of “fun” led to unexpected resonance with a global audience. Rather than targeting a specific market segment, I deliberately avoided conventional business-driven decision-making during development. This allowed me to fully express my creative intent without being constrained by trends, metrics, or external expectations.

Interestingly, this approach did not result in a niche product, but instead attracted strong support from players overseas, including audiences I had not originally anticipated. This experience revealed that differentiation is not about chasing what is currently popular, but about creating something genuinely engaging that can connect with people on a deeper level.

In this session, I will discuss how balancing personal vision with openness to external feedback can create a sustainable development approach. I will also share practical insights into how small teams can achieve both creative authenticity and global reach, without being driven solely by market trends.

Ultimately, this talk presents a perspective on how “ego” and “market” can function as two complementary pillars, enabling developers to create games that are both meaningful and widely appreciated.

schedules.topic_zh: 虚幻引擎 5.8：全栈技术升级
schedules.topic_en: Unreal Engine 5.8: Full-Stack Advancements

speakers.title_zh: Epic Games大中华区技术解决方案负责人
speakers.title_en: Technical Director，Developer Relations at Epic Games
speakers.introduction_zh:
现任Epic Games中国技术工程师（开发者关系）技术总监，在Epic Games中国为虚幻引擎提供技术支持，帮助虚幻引擎项目解决各种问题。有10多年的游戏开发经验，开发过自研引擎，对引擎的各个功能模块都有了解，擅长渲染及效率优化。有10年虚幻引擎的使用经验，从事过端游、手游及APP的开发。

演讲内容摘要：

介绍虚幻引擎各核心模块的最新路线图，涵盖渲染功能、动画系统、物理系统、开发迭代、编辑器功能及移动平台；随后重点解读UE5.8版本中所作的各项功能优化；继而介绍多项开发中的渲染功能，包括MegaLights、Nanite Foliage与Substrate；最后阐述5.8版本中与AI结合的开发流程。
speakers.introduction_en:
Current Technical Director of Developer Relations at Epic Games China, providing technical support for Unreal Engine and helping developers resolve various project bottlenecks. With over 10 years of game development experience, Wei Liu has previously developed in-house game engines and possess a comprehensive understanding of all core engine modules, specializing in rendering and performance optimization. Wei also brings a decade of hands-on experience with Unreal Engine, spanning the development of PC games, mobile games, and applications.

Abstract：

This presentation introduces the latest roadmap across Unreal Engine's core modules—covering rendering features, animation systems, physics systems, developer iteration, editor functionality, and mobile platforms. Following this overview, we will focus on a detailed breakdown of the various feature optimizations introduced in UE 5.8. We will then dive into several rendering features currently in active development, including MegaLights, Nanite Foliage, and Substrate. Finally, we will illustrate the AI-integrated development workflows featured in version 5.8.

schedules.topic_zh: 《幻兽帕鲁》全纪录：从创意到全球想象
schedules.topic_en: Palworld: Inception to 1.0, The Palworld Journey!

speakers.title_zh: Pocketpair发行与公关总监
speakers.title_en: Head of Publishing & Communications at Pocketpair
speakers.introduction_zh:
John "Bucky" Buckley 现任发行与公关总监，是一位将热爱变为事业的资深游戏玩家。他在爱尔兰出生长大，于2012年移居日本，投身游戏行业。虽然最初花了数年时间才找到自己的方向，但他最终成为 Pocketpair 不可或缺的核心成员，现担任公司发行与公关总监一职。John 还参与了多款 Pocketpair 游戏的本地化及游戏设计工作。随着《幻兽帕鲁》（Palworld）取得瞩目成功，John 逐渐成为公司重要的公众代言人，持续担任 Pocketpair 与全球玩家社区之间的沟通桥梁。

 

演讲内容摘要：

《幻兽帕鲁》于2024年1月19日正式进入抢先体验阶段，迅速成为游戏界最引人瞩目的黑马之一。本次演讲将全面回顾《幻兽帕鲁》的发展过程——从发售前的开发阶段，到迈向正式版1.0的完整路径，涵盖游戏的诞生、重要里程碑、所获荣誉、面临的挑战以及社区的深度参与。通过追溯《幻兽帕鲁》从创意到全球现象的成长轨迹，深入探讨 Pocketpair 如何构建、发行并持续打磨这款俘获无数玩家心灵、与社区共同成长的游戏。
speakers.introduction_en:
John “Bucky” Buckley is a lifelong gamer who transformed his passion into a career. Born and raised in Ireland, John moved to Japan in 2012 to immerse himself in the gaming industry. Although it took him a few years to find his footing, he eventually became an integral part of Pocketpair, where he now serves as the Head of Publishing & Communications. John has also contributed to the localisation and game design of several Pocketpair titles. Following the remarkable success of Palworld, John has become a prominent public figure for the company and continues to act as the liaison between Pocketpair and the global Pocketpair community.

 

Abstract：

Released into Early Access on January 19, 2024, Palworld quickly became one of gaming’s biggest breakout stories. This talk explores the full history of Palworld, from pre-release development through its path toward version 1.0, covering the game’s creation, major milestones, accolades, challenges, and community involvement. By following Palworld from concept to global phenomenon, this talk reflects on how Pocketpair built, launched, and continued shaping a game that captured players’ imaginations and grew alongside its community.

schedules.topic_zh: 从独立开发到工作室：《异变金属》的成长之路
schedules.topic_en: From Solo to Studio: The Morbid Metal Journey

speakers.title_zh: SCREEN JUICE创始人兼游戏总监
speakers.title_en: Founder & Game Director at SCREEN JUICE
speakers.introduction_zh:
《异变金属》起初是Felix Schade的第一款游戏，构思于他在大学攻读游戏设计专业期间。从2017年开始，他独自开发了数年，直到2023年创立了Screen Juice工作室。一个关键转折点出现在Schade把早期游戏画面和概念发布到网上，在Reddit等社交平台上寻求反馈时。游戏社区迅速对此产生了热烈回响，由此积累的关注度吸引了多家大型发行商的目光，这股势头也推动了游戏后续的发展。之后，Schade在担任游戏总监的同时，也持续不断扩大公司规模。

 

演讲内容摘要：

从学生实验项目到正式发行游戏，《异变金属》记录了一位开发者意外踏上职业游戏开发之路的故事。Screen Juice创始人、CEO兼游戏总监Felix Schade，讲述了他从一名在Unity里摸索的游戏设计学生，到带领工作室推出正式作品的心路历程。

Schade坦言自己最初的预期：一款一两年内完成的小型游戏、几个有趣的机制、一种平常的生活节奏。然而现实截然不同。他发现自己要注册公司、处理税务申报、支付软件授权费用、与发行商谈判、制作无休止的表格、招募和管理团队，还要学会放权/授权，而不是每隔六个月就把所有系统推倒重来。

他与《异变金属》共同成长——游戏也从粗糙的学生原型，一路打磨成熟的版本最终在Steam上发布了抢先体验版。贯穿演讲始终的，是他对"冒名顶替综合症"的坦诚，以及对团队的感谢，正是他们支撑他走到了抢先体验发布。这是一场真诚而不失幽默的分享，讲述的是如何将一个热情驱动的个人项目，转变为一个可持续发展的工作室和一款真正面世的游戏。
speakers.introduction_en:
Morbid Metal began as Felix Schade's first game, conceived while he was studying game design at university. Starting in 2017, he spent years developing it solo before founding Screen Juice in 2023. A pivotal moment came when Schade shared early gameplay footage and concepts online, seeking feedback on Reddit and other socials. The gaming community quickly embraced it, and the traction it gained attracted the attention of major publishers, sparking momentum that helped shape the game's evolution. Since then, Schade has expanded the company while continuing to lead as game director.

 

Abstract

From student experiment to published game, Morbid Metal is the story of one developer's unexpected journey into professional game development. Felix Schade — Founder, CEO, and Game Director at Screen Juice — traces his path from a game design student tinkering with Unity to leading a studio with a released title.

Schade is candid about his original expectations: a small first game finished in one or two years, a few cool mechanics, and a normal routine. Reality differed sharply. He found himself setting up a company, handling tax filings, paying software licenses, negotiating with publishers, producing endless spreadsheets, hiring and managing a team, and learning to delegate rather than rebuild every system every six months.

Both he and Morbid Metal evolved, with the game progressing from rough student prototype to polished build to an Early Access release on Steam. Underpinning the talk is an honest acknowledgment of impostor syndrome and the team that supported him toward a EA release. The talk is an honest, often humorous look at what it takes to turn a passion project into a sustainable studio and a shipped game.

schedules.topic_zh: Xsolla：游戏的发布-增长-成功全链路服务专家
schedules.topic_en: Xsolla: The Full-Chain Service Expert for Game Publishing, Growth, and Success

speakers.title_zh: Xsolla大中华区商务拓展负责人
speakers.title_en: Business Development Head at Xsolla
speakers.introduction_zh:
Bono Wu， Xsolla 大中华区商务拓展负责人，拥有超过 15 年游戏、移动互联网及全球化商务经验。此前任职小米海外广告，先后负责全球渠道合作及欧美市场销售负责人。现致力于帮助中国游戏企业拓展全球市场，通过支付、Web Shop及商业化解决方案，推动游戏业务的全球增长。

演讲内容摘要：

Xsolla作为全球领先的电子游戏商务公司，为开发者提供覆盖游戏发布至成功的全矩阵解决方案。通过成熟的MoR（交易全权代理商）模式，Xsolla全权负责全球合规、税务处理及反欺诈管理，助力厂商无忧出海。此外，凭借高性能的DTC变现工具（如Web Shop）及覆盖全球200多个国家和地区的支付网络，Xsolla帮助合作伙伴优化变现效率、提升用户体验并降低财务运营成本，从而实现全球范围内的营收增长与业务拓展。
speakers.introduction_en:
Bono Wu, Head of Business Development for Xsolla Greater China, has over 15 years of experience in gaming, mobile internet, and global commerce. He previously worked at Xiaomi's overseas advertising division, where he served as Head of Global Channel Partnerships and Head of Sales for European and American markets. He is now dedicated to helping Chinese gaming companies expand into global markets, driving worldwide business growth through payment solutions, Web Shop, and monetization solutions.

Abstract：

As a globally leading video game commerce company, Xsolla provides developers with a full-matrix solution covering everything from game publishing to success. Through its proven MoR (Merchant of Record) model, Xsolla takes full responsibility for global compliance, tax processing, and fraud management, enabling publishers to expand overseas with peace of mind. In addition, with high-performance DTC monetization tools such as Web Shop and a payment network covering over 200 countries and regions worldwide, Xsolla helps partners optimize monetization efficiency, enhance user experience, and reduce financial operating costs — driving revenue growth and business expansion on a global scale.

schedules.topic_zh: 让 AI 走进游戏：构建实时交互智能系统
schedules.topic_en: Bringing AI into Games: Building Real-Time Interactive AI Systems

speakers.title_zh: 英伟达半导体科技上海有限公司开发者技术工程师
speakers.title_en: Developer Technology Engineer at  NVIDIA Semiconductor Technology Shanghai Co., Ltd.
speakers.introduction_zh:
赵波，AI 开发者，拥有游戏开发、GPU 驱动开发及 GPU 架构设计等多领域技术背景。长期从事高性能计算与人工智能相关工作，研究方向涵盖大语言模型、强化学习、多模态 AI 以及 GPU 加速计算，致力于推动前沿 AI 技术在实际场景中的应用与落地。

演讲内容摘要：

大模型在语言、视觉、语音和推理等领域取得了突破性进展，但如何将这些能力真正应用于游戏，仍面临实时性能、低延迟、可控性、一致性以及与游戏引擎深度集成等诸多挑战。本次演讲将围绕如何用AI构建实时交互智能系统展开，探讨如何将基础模型打造为适用于游戏生产环境的 AI 系统，分享交互式 AI 角色、多模态感知、智能决策、GPU 加速推理等关键技术，以及模型部署与运行时优化的实践经验。通过真实案例，介绍如何连接前沿 AI 技术与现代游戏开发需求，构建高性能、可扩展、沉浸式的智能游戏体验。
speakers.introduction_en:
Bo Zhao is an AI developer with a multidisciplinary background in game development, GPU driver engineering, and GPU architecture. His work focuses on high-performance computing and artificial intelligence, with research interests spanning large language models, reinforcement learning, multimodal AI, and GPU-accelerated computing. He is dedicated to advancing cutting-edge AI technologies and translating research into practical, real-world applications.

Abstract：

Foundation AI models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across language, vision, audio, and reasoning. However, deploying these models in games presents unique challenges, including real-time performance, latency, consistency, controllability, and tight integration with game engines. This talk explores what it takes to transform powerful foundation models into interactive AI systems. We will discuss the architecture, optimization strategies, and runtime considerations behind interactive AI characters, multimodal perception, decision-making, and GPU-accelerated inference. Through practical examples, the session highlights how developers can bridge cutting-edge AI research with the demanding requirements of modern game production, enabling immersive, scalable, and responsive player experiences.

schedules.topic_zh: AAA: Good Games Still Fail
schedules.topic_en: AAA: Good Games Still Fail

speakers.title_zh: Ruckus Games联合创始人、CEO兼游戏总监
speakers.title_en: Co-founder, CEO, and Game Director of Ruckus Games
speakers.introduction_zh:
Paul Sage是Ruckus Games的联合创始人、CEO兼游戏总监。作为一名享有盛誉的创意总监，保罗参与塑造了游戏行业中一些最受喜爱的世界——在其职业生涯中，他曾先后任职于Gearbox、ZeniMax Online、NCSoft和Origin Systems等工作室，主导了《无主之地3》《上古卷轴OL》和《网络创世纪》的创意方向。

 

在Ruckus，保罗与首席技术官Jesse McIntyre携手合作。Jesse是一位领先的游戏引擎技术专家，拥有在Riot Games、Spry Fox和ZeniMax的工作经验。他们的核心团队成员均来自Gearbox、Riot、Blizzard、Epic、Monolith等知名公司，团队累计贡献的PC/主机游戏营收超过50亿美元，使Ruckus成为业内经验最丰富、配合最默契的团队之一。

 

目前，该团队正将其在射击游戏领域的深厚积累倾注于新作《The Holdouts》——一款高强度的第三人称、基于对局的合作射击游戏，核心理念围绕“破坏、夺取、成长”三大支柱展开。玩家将在变异的小镇街区中横冲直撞，就地取材，将园艺工具、电动工具、厨房电器和复古八轨磁带玩具改造成武器，奋力反击，在新现实中重建家园。

 

《The Holdouts》目前已进入玩家测试阶段，并已在Steam上开放愿望单添加。
speakers.introduction_en:
Paul Sage is the co-founder, CEO, and Game Director of Ruckus Games. A renowned creative director, Paul has helped shape some of the most beloved worlds in gaming — leading creative direction on Borderlands 3, The Elder Scrolls Online, and Ultima Online across a career at studios including Gearbox, ZeniMax Online, NCSoft, and Origin Systems.

 

At Ruckus, Paul is joined by CTO Jesse McIntyre, a leading game-engine technologist with experience at Riot Games, Spry Fox, and ZeniMax. Their core team — veterans of Gearbox, Riot, Blizzard, Epic, Monolith, and more — has collectively shipped over $5B in PC/console revenue, making Ruckus one of the most seasoned and cohesive teams in the industry. 

 

The team is now applying its deep experience in shooters to The Holdouts, a high-octane, third-person, session-based co-op shooter built on the pillars of "Smash, Grab, and Grow." Players bash through warped small-town neighborhoods, improvising weapons from lawn equipment, power tools, kitchen appliances, and vintage 8-track toys to fight back and rebuild a home in a warped new reality.  

 

The Holdouts is currently in playtesting and available to wishlist on Steam.

schedules.topic_zh: PLAYISM支持独创性游戏的理由 ——独立游戏发行商的生存战略
schedules.topic_en: “Why PLAYISM Supports Original Games” — The Survival Strategy of an Indie Game Publisher

speakers.title_zh: PLAYISM执行董事兼事业本部部长
speakers.title_en: Executive Officer and Division Director at PLAYISM
speakers.introduction_zh:
Active Gaming Media股份有限公司执行董事兼游戏发行事业本部部长，独立游戏发行品牌 PLAYISM 负责人。长期从事全球独立游戏的发行与推广工作，主导并参与《8号出口》《GNOSIA》《光明记忆：无限》等数百款海内外独立游戏的发掘、评估、签约与发行流程。同时负责整体宣传策略的制定与执行，包括市场推广、活动企划以及跨平台合作协调等工作，推动作品在全球市场的曝光与商业化落地。在行业内持续关注及推动独立游戏的发展，致力于支持具有独创性与创作个性的作品走向国际市场。

 

演讲内容摘要：

PLAYISM作为独立游戏发行商，曾推出《Ib》《光明记忆》《非常普通的鹿》《螃蟹大战》《8号出口》等众多中小规模独立游戏作品。

在作品选择方面，PLAYISM始终重视“是否具有独创性”以及“是否是只有该创作者才能完成的作品”。这不仅是一种理念，更是在竞争日益激烈的独立游戏市场中生存下去的一种现实商业战略。

在如今每天都有大量游戏发布的环境下，仅仅“有趣的游戏”已经难以脱颖而出，作品很容易被淹没。本次演讲将结合过往案例与市场变化，基于选题标准，探讨小型团队如何在全球市场中建立自身存在感并获得成功。
speakers.introduction_en:
Executive Director of Active Gaming Media Co., Ltd. and Head of the Game Publishing Division, leading the indie game publishing brand PLAYISM.

 

Has extensive experience in the global indie game industry, overseeing the publishing and promotion of independent games worldwide. Led and participated in the discovery, evaluation, licensing, and publishing processes of hundreds of indie titles, including titles such as The Exit 8, GNOSIA, and Bright Memory: Infinite.

 

Also responsible for planning and executing overall marketing and promotion strategies, including public relations, event planning, and cross-platform partnership coordination, helping titles expand their global presence and commercial success.

 

Actively supports and promotes the growth of the indie game industry, with a strong focus on bringing original and creative indie titles to international audiences.

 

Abstract：

As an indie game publisher, PLAYISM has released a wide range of independent titles, including Ib, Bright Memory, DEEEER Simulator, Fight Crab, and The Exit 8.

 

When selecting projects, PLAYISM has always placed strong importance on originality and on whether the game is something that could only be created by that particular developer. This is not only a creative philosophy, but also a practical business strategy for surviving in the increasingly competitive indie game market.

 

Today, with countless new games being released every day, simply making a “fun game” is often no longer enough to stand out. Many titles quickly become buried in the market.

 

In this session, we will look back at past case studies and recent market trends to discuss how small teams can establish a unique presence and achieve success in the global market through strong creative identity and distinctive game concepts.

schedules.topic_zh: 团结引擎并行渲染架构介绍
schedules.topic_en: Introduction to Tuanjie Engine's Parallel Rendering Architecture

speakers.title_zh: Unity中国平台技术总监
speakers.title_en: Unity China Platform Technology Director
speakers.introduction_zh:
杨栋目前担任Unity中国平台技术总监，他所管理的团队负责为汽车智能座舱设计基于Unity引擎的HMI技术解决方案和产品，以及深度参与Unity引擎开发者生态的发展。他拥有丰富的Unity开发经验，一直致力于将Unity引擎的最新技术推广给广大开发者，并出版了《创造高清3D虚拟世界：Unity引擎HDRP高清渲染管线实战》 和《Unity智能座舱HMI开发指南》。

演讲内容摘要：

长期以来，游戏引擎的逻辑模拟（Simulation）和渲染（Render）任务重度堆积在主线程，导致提交线程常处于闲置状态，成为了制约性能的核心瓶颈。为了打破这一限制，释放更多算力，团结引擎对底层渲染架构进行了深度重构。

本次演讲将介绍团结引擎1.9版本中实现的“并行渲染”底层技术与工程实践。讲师将介绍：

  1. 如何通过架构重构，使主线程CPU消耗显著降低10%~30%，设备功耗降低7%~15%，并带来10%~15%的帧数（FPS）提升
  2. 深入探讨双缓冲Proxy Buffer的运作原理、Fill Proxy同步点设计，以及脚本在渲染线程的安全执行方案
  3. 技术演进与展望： 探讨该架构目前的内存等妥协限制，以及未来全面支持HDRP、URP、Builtin多管线与跨平台的技术蓝图
speakers.introduction_en:
YANG DONG is currently the Platform Technology Director at Unity China. He leads a team that designs Unity engine based HMI technology solutions and products for automotive clients. With extensive experience in Unity application development, he has long been committed to bringing the engine’s latest technologies to the broader developer community. He is the author of two Unity books: “A Practical Guide to Unity’s HDRP” and the “Unity HMI Developer Guide”.

 

Abstract：

For a long time, the main thread has been heavily loaded with both simulation and render tasks in game engines, leaving the submission thread largely idle and creating a critical performance bottleneck. To break through this limitation and unlock more computing power, Tuanjie Engine has deeply re-architected its underlying rendering system.

This talk will introduce the low-level technology and engineering practices of "parallel rendering" implemented in Tuanjie Engine version 1.9. The speaker will cover:

  1. How architectural refactoring reduces main thread CPU consumption by 10–30%, lowers device power consumption by 7–15%, and delivers a 10–15% increase in FPS.
  2. An in-depth discussion of the working principles of the double-buffered Proxy Buffer, the design of the Fill Proxy synchronization point, and the safe execution of scripting logic on the rendering thread.
  3. Technology evolution and outlook: We will also explore the current memory-related trade-offs and limitations of this architecture, as well as the technical roadmap for full future support of HDRP, URP, Built-in pipelines, and cross-platform operation.

schedules.topic_zh: 独立游戏的长线发展经验分享
schedules.topic_en: Sharing Experience in Long-Term Development of Indie Games

speakers.title_zh: Producer at Conchship Games
speakers.title_en: 螺舟工作室制作人
speakers.introduction_zh:
2013年发布个人单独制作的独立游戏《末日文书》，并开始寻找《太吾绘卷》的合作伙伴

2018年9月于STEAM发布《太吾绘卷》，年末成立螺舟公司进行专业的游戏制作

2022年9月于STEAM发布完全重构的新版《太吾绘卷》

2026年6月《太吾绘卷》结束EA，发布经历大幅迭代的新版本《太吾绘卷：天幕心帷》

演讲内容摘要：

大部分独立游戏的发展方向，都是短小精悍，不断创作新品为主，但也有例外，在全球范围内也不乏长线经营的独立游戏，太吾绘卷也是其中一员，希望在此向大家分享一些我们的经验。
speakers.introduction_en:
2013: Released the independently developed solo game The Book of The Judgement Day and began seeking partners for The Scroll of Taiwu.

September 2018: Released The Scroll of Taiwu on Steam. Established Conchship Games at the end of the year to pursue professional game development.

September 2022: Released a completely rebuilt new version of The Scroll of Taiwu on Steam.

June 2026: The Scroll of Taiwu exits Early Access, launching a significantly iterated new version, The Scroll of Taiwu: Beyond The Dome.

Abstract:

Most indie games tend to be compact and punchy, with developers focusing on continuously creating new titles. However, there are exceptions. Around the world, there are also indie games that thrive through long-term operation, and The Scroll of Taiwu is one of them. I would like to take this opportunity to share some of our experiences with you.

schedules.topic_zh: 矮人，数据与断点：10年开放开发的坦诚分享
schedules.topic_en: Dwarves, Data, and Disconnects: Honest Learnings from 10 Years of Open Development

speakers.title_zh: Ghost Ship Games  CEO
speakers.title_en: CEO at Ghost Ship Games
speakers.introduction_zh:
Søren是游戏业的资深从业者，有超过25年的跨平台全球游戏开发经验。

他早期在Deadline Games担任主程，后来转向游戏总监的角色，主要做PC和主机动作游戏。在教育领域待了几年后，他于2016年回归游戏行业，成为Ghost Ship Games的创始核心成员之一，并担任CEO至今。同时，他也是丹麦游戏产业协会Games Denmark的会长。

演讲内容摘要：

Ghost Ship Gam从藉藉无名的独立工作室成长为全球IP的掌舵者，这场分享会回顾整个成长历程。从《深岩星际》的早期开放开发、与Coffee Stain的关键合作，到突破1200万玩家的里程碑，我们会讲述这个IP如何一步步站稳脚跟。

  • 国内外市场拓展的实战经验— 如何进入中国市场，应对网易平台的变化
  • IP衍生品的商业化尝试— 桌游版和《DRG: Survivor》的成功案例
  • 一次代价沉重的教训— 最新衍生作品《DRG: Rogue Core》的早期进场失利

这款新作本来野心很大，但高门槛的玩法与玩家预期的脱节，加上中国区定价策略的失误，直接引发了社区反弹。Ghost Ship没有硬撑，而是回归初心：扒数据、听玩家声音、一个月内完成核心玩法重做，扭转了局面。

这次坦诚的"事后分析"对国内外开发者都很有参考价值：

  • 如何通过高频次运营维持玩家粘性
  • 如何与外部合作方高效协作
  • 如何在多款衍生品间平衡IP的核心调性

这场分享想传递的最关键的信息：当产品首发遭遇滑铁卢时，为什么"透明度+谦虚态度+快速迭代"才是王牌。
speakers.introduction_en:
Søren is a game industry veteran with more than 25 years of diverse experience developing games for the global market on multiple platforms.
Søren started out as a lead programmer and later transitioned to game director at Deadline Games making action games for PC and console. 
After a few years in the education field, he returned to the games industry and in 2016 he became part of the founding group of Ghost Ship Games where he took on the CEO role.
Søren is also chairman of the board in Games Denmark, the national association for the Danish game industry.

Abstract

This talk explores Ghost Ship Games’ decade-long journey from a fledgling indie studio to the curators of a massive global IP. It traces Deep Rock Galactic’s evolution from early open development and an impactful partnership with Coffee Stain to achieving over 12 million players. The studio will share triumphs and critical business learnings from expanding into the Chinese market, navigating NetEase platform shifts, and scaling the franchise through successful spin-offs like the Deep Rock Galactic Board Game and DRG: Survivor.

Crucially, the presentation dives into the turbulent early access launch of their latest spin-off, DRG: Rogue Core. When an ambitious, high-friction design misaligned with community expectations—and a pricing disconnect sparked backlash among Chinese players—Ghost Ship returned to its roots. By leveraging extensive survey data, listening to a remarkably loyal fanbase, and quickly deploying fundamental gameplay overhauls, the team course-corrected within a month.

This transparent post-mortem provides international and domestic developers alike with honest, data-driven insights. Attendees will learn how to maintain player retention through fast-paced live-ops, effectively collaborate with external partners, and balance franchise identity across multiple spin-offs. Ultimately, the session demonstrates the invaluable power of radical transparency, humility, and swift adaptation when a high-stakes launch doesn't go to plan.

schedules.topic_zh: 从PC到主机：《三角洲行动》的跨平台移植与次世代适配实践
schedules.topic_en: From PC to Console: Practical Experience in Cross-Platform Porting and Next-Gen Adaptation of Chinese-Made FPS Games

speakers.title_zh: 维塔士高级游戏制作人
speakers.title_en: Senior Game Producer at Virtuos
speakers.introduction_zh:
唐萌佳，目前担任维塔士成都工作室高级游戏制作人，拥有二十年的游戏行业经验。曾主导多个跨PC、主机和移动平台的项目，包括《NBA 2K》系列、《使命召唤》系列等大型项目，带领百人以上团队完成复杂的技术交付。唐萌佳具备任天堂Switch游戏开发与认证经验，曾负责《黑暗之魂™：重制版》的制作。现阶段，她负责统筹管理工作室的游戏开发项目，并积极推动制作人才培养和团队能力建设。

演讲内容摘要：

随着国产游戏加速登陆主机平台，高质量的跨平台开发成为行业关注的重点。在存量竞争和全球化发行的背景下，跨平台开发不仅推动技术升级，也对开发流程和用户体验提出更高要求。本次分享以FPS项目从PC到主机的移植为例，重点介绍维塔士在移植交付过程中的技术方法和流程创新，包括双线并行开发的节奏管理、硬件与手柄适配、UI/UX体验重构、主机合规认证等核心挑战，以及协作机制和技术优化策略。我们将探讨如何在有限周期内平衡性能和画质，并将项目经验转化为可复用的行业方法，为国产游戏实现高品质跨平台开发提供可复用的协同开发参考。
speakers.introduction_en:
Tang Mengjia, currently serves as Senior Game Producer at the Virtuos Chengdu Studio, with over 20 years of experience in the game industry. Has led multiple cross-platform projects spanning PC, console, and mobile, including major titles such as the NBA 2K series and Call of Duty series. Successfully managed teams of over 100 members to deliver complex technical implementations. Tang Mengjia possesses extensive experience in Nintendo Switch game development and certification, and was responsible for the production of Dark Souls™: Remastered. Currently responsible for overall planning and management of the studio’s game development projects, while actively driving production talent program and team capability building.

Abstract：

As domestic games increasingly enter console platforms, high-quality cross-platform development has become a central focus within the industry. In the context of heightened competition and global distribution, cross-platform development is driving technological progress and setting higher standards for development processes and user experience. This presentation examines an FPS project’s adaptation from PC to console, showcasing Virtuos’ technical solutions and process innovations throughout the porting and delivery stages. Key areas covered include dual-track parallel development, hardware and controller adaptation, UI/UX redesign, console compliance certification, collaboration frameworks, and technical optimization strategies. We will discuss methods for balancing performance and visual quality within tight timelines, and how project learnings can be translated into industry best practices to support collaborative, high-quality cross-platform development for domestic games.

schedules.topic_zh: 从“造物主”到“共生者”：AI 时代的游戏创作与体验革命 (暂定)
schedules.topic_en: From "Sole Creator" to "Symbiont": The Revolution of Game Creation and Experience in the Age of AI

speakers.title_zh: SODA GAME CEO
speakers.title_en: CEO at SODA GAME
speakers.introduction_zh:
SODA GAME CEO, 前字节和腾讯全栈设计师，24 年从大厂离职进入游戏行业创业，运用 AI 开发多款 Steam游戏，最新款 AI 率超过 90% 优化工作流，大幅降低成本。2026 年开始开发 AI 游戏平台 ORBIT，将成为行业领先的AI 游戏和创作平台。

演讲内容摘要 

机器人跳不出有灵魂的冰上舞蹈，没有人类情感注入的 AI 游戏注定比 Mini Game 还要乏味。AI 虽极大降低了成本，却因缺乏“读心术”而无法独自承载文化的表达。未来的破局点，在于 AI 如何转型为人类的联合制作人。当高成本壁垒被打破，玩家的习惯将从“50小时玩1款游戏”转向“50小时体验500款高质短内容”，催生出切片化、连载制的全新消费模式。通过与人类的双向蒸馏，AI 将成为具备主动性的超级合伙人，开启一个万亿级的 AI 合伙人经济新时代。
speakers.introduction_en:
Founder & CEO of SODA GAME. Formerly a full-stack designer at ByteDance and Tencent, Jeff pivoted from tech giants to indie game development in 2024. As a pioneer in AI-augmented workflows, his latest Steam project achieved a 90%+ AI integration rate, radically cutting production costs. In 2026, he launched the development of ORBIT—a next-generation AI gaming platform built to become the industry's leading ecosystem for AI-driven games and interactive creation.

Abstract 

Robots cannot perform an ice dance with a soul, and AI games devoid of human emotion are destined to be even more tedious than mindless mini-games. While AI drastically slashes costs, its lack of "mind-reading" capabilities means it cannot carry the weight of cultural expression alone. The future breakthrough lies in AI’s transition into humanity's co-producer. As high cost barriers dissolve, player habits will shift from "spending 50 hours on a single game" to "experiencing 500 high-quality, short-form contents in those same 50 hours," fueling a brand-new consumption paradigm of episodic, sliced, and subscription-based games. Through bidirectional distillation with humans, AI will evolve into a proactive super-partner, ushering in a multi-trillion-dollar era of the AI Copilot Economy.

schedules.topic_zh: 出海指南：如何让西方媒体主动报道你的游戏
schedules.topic_en: Going global: How to get Western media to cover your game

speakers.title_zh: IGN JAPAN执行制作人
speakers.title_en: Executive Producer at IGN JAPAN
speakers.introduction_zh:
Daniel Robson 是 IGN JAPAN的执行制片人。他出生于英国，自 2006 年起定居日本，拥有 25 年的流行文化媒体从业经验，长期为数十家主流媒体撰写音乐、电子游戏、电影及日本流行文化相关内容。曾在索尼电脑娱乐日本工作室任职，2016 年加入日本知名媒体Sankei Digital，以主编身份创立 IGN 日本，现任执行制片人。Daniel 负责统筹 IGN 日本品牌，出品高质量的游戏与电影资讯内容，同时参与Sankei Digital旗下的商业项目及游戏行业业务拓展。

座谈内容摘要：

越来越多的中国游戏正在走向全球，并在海外市场取得亮眼成绩。然而面对每月数百款新游的激烈竞争，如何确保海外媒体关注并报道你的游戏？在本场座谈中，资深游戏媒体人 Daniel Robson（IGN 日本）与 Chris James（Pocket Gamer）将携手中国游戏发行商 Jokery Z（Astrolabe Games）及 Sean Li（Thermite Games），共同探讨如何与西方及亚洲媒体建立连接、如何帮助媒体更便捷地评测你的游戏以提升 Metascore 评分，以及如何灵活运用免费与付费资源，在中国以外的市场触达尽可能广泛的受众。
speakers.introduction_en:
Daniel Robson is the Executive Producer of IGN JAPAN. Born in England and a resident of Japan since 2006, Daniel has over 25 years of experience in pop-culture media, focusing on music, videogames, movies and Japanese pop culture for dozens of major publications. After a period at Sony Computer Entertainment’s Japan Studio, in 2016 Daniel joined Japanese news leader Sankei Digital to launch IGN JAPAN as Chief Editor, and now as Executive Producer. Daniel oversees the IGN JAPAN brand to publish best-in-class videogame and movie coverage, as well as working on commercial projects and other game industry business initiatives within Sankei Digital.

Abstarct:

More and more games from China are reaching a global audience and finding great success around the world. But with fierce competition from the hundreds of other games released every month, how can you ensure media overseas cover your game? In this session, veteran game journalists Daniel Robson (IGN JAPAN) and Chris James (Pocket Gamer) will discuss with Chinese game publishers Jokery Z (Astrolabe Games) and Sean Li (Thermite Games) will share insights and strategies for connecting with Western and Asian media, methods to make it easier for them to review your games and improve your Metascore, and ways to leverage free and paid options to reach the widest possible audience outside of China.

speakers.title_en: Managing Director & Editor in Chief at Pocket Gamer

But with fierce competition from the hundreds of other games released every month, how can you ensure media overseas cover your game? speakers.title_zh: 热脉游戏创始人
speakers.title_en: co-founder at Thermite Games
speakers.introduction_zh:
座谈内容摘要：

越来越多的中国游戏正在走向全球，并在海外市场取得亮眼成绩。然而面对每月数百款新游的激烈竞争，如何确保海外媒体关注并报道你的游戏？在本场座谈中，资深游戏媒体人 Daniel Robson（IGN 日本）与 Chris James（Pocket Gamer）将携手中国游戏发行商 Jokery Z（Astrolabe Games）及 Sean Li（Thermite Games），共同探讨如何与西方及亚洲媒体建立连接、如何帮助媒体更便捷地评测你的游戏以提升 Metascore 评分，以及如何灵活运用免费与付费资源，在中国以外的市场触达尽可能广泛的受众。
speakers.introduction_en:
Abstarct:

More and more games from China are reaching a global audience and finding great success around the world. But with fierce competition from the hundreds of other games released every month, how can you ensure media overseas cover your game? In this session, veteran game journalists Daniel Robson (IGN JAPAN) and Chris James (Pocket Gamer) will discuss with Chinese game publishers Jokery Z (Astrolabe Games) and Sean Li (Thermite Games) will share insights and strategies for connecting with Western and Asian media, methods to make it easier for them to review your games and improve your Metascore, and ways to leverage free and paid options to reach the widest possible audience outside of China.

schedules.topic_zh: 恐怖之声——解构《REANIMAL》的氛围音景
schedules.topic_en: The Sounds of Horror: Deconstructing the Atmospheric Soundscape of REANIMAL

speakers.title_zh: Tarsier Studios音频设计师
speakers.title_en: Audio Designer at Tarsier Studios
speakers.introduction_zh:
我在Tarsier Studios担任音频设计师已有三年。我有幸以技术音频设计师的身份参与了《Reanimal》的开发，负责音效设计、音频整合以及游戏中的技术系统。我认为自己是全能型，从音效设计到在Wwise和Unreal Engine 5中的音频整合，包括作曲，所有音频相关的工作我都有涉及（但我并非《Reanimal》的作曲师）。在加入Tarsier之前，我曾作为自由音效设计师参与多个独立游戏项目，其中最具代表性的是Studio Mantasaur的《All Hands On Deck》。在游戏行业之外，我也有担任录音和混音师的经验。

 

演讲内容摘要：

在《REANIMAL》中，音景不仅仅是恐怖氛围的陪衬——它是将玩家与这个破碎、充满氛围感的世界紧密相连的心理纽带。

作为技术音效设计师，我不仅有机会参与设计烘托孤立感、恐惧感与衰败感的音频，还将其整合进一套流畅、动态响应的音频生态系统里。

本次演讲会让听众了解构建《REANIMAL》音景所运用的创作理念与技术系统：

首先，我们先聊《REANIMAL》中的怪物。为了唤起一种诡异感、熟悉感与恐惧感，我们以现实世界为基础来设计这些怪物。我们将探讨如何对真实的、有机的动物叫声进行处理、叠加与加工，从而创造出既令人毛骨悚然、又真实可信的怪物音效，同时也会涉及部分创作理念与技术实现。

从生物层面转向机械，演讲将转向游戏中的交互式载具与机械系统——例如小船、冰淇淋车、大风扇和滚筒机。我们将探讨《REANIMAL》世界中更技术感的一面，例如我们如何设计出那些感觉破败、荒凉、且不属于任何特定时代的机械。

我们将深入剖析其背后的技术实现，探讨如何运用动态参数调制、实时物理追踪以及游戏状态，让这些载具呈现出真实可信的质感——听起来像是真实存在的，突突作响的，摇摇欲坠的破败机械。

最后，演讲将探讨环境音效世界构建这一主题，聚焦于克制与悬念的力量。在我们的游戏中，你听不到的声音往往与你听到的同样重要。我们将分析《REANIMAL》如何运用悬念与极简主义，营造出一种压抑、沉重的氛围。同时探讨我们的环境音效系统如何动态变化——以荒芜感作为结构性手段，唤起一种被遗弃的孤寂感，并与游戏中高强度、混乱的高潮场景形成对比，进一步放大冲击力。
speakers.introduction_en:
I have been working at Tarsier Studios for the past 3 years as an Audio Designer. I had the chance to work on Reanimal as a Technical Audio Designer, so I did both sound design and implementation and technical systems on the game too. I view myself as a generalist, I do everything audio related from sound design to audio implementation in Wwise and Unreal Engine 5 as well as composing (I was not a composer for Reanimal). Before working at Tarsier, I was a freelance sound designer on various indie projects, most notably Studio Mantasaur´s´All Hands On Deck´. Outside of the game industry, I have experience as a record and mixing engineer.



Abstract:


In REANIMAL, the soundscape is not just an accompaniment to horror—it is the psychological connective tissue that binds the players to our fractured, atmospheric world. As a technical sound designer, I had the opportunity to not only take part in designing the audio that aims to underline isolation, dread, and decay but to integrate it into a seamless, responsive audio ecosystem.

This presentation is intended to allow the listeners a look into the creative philosophies and technical systems used to build REANIMAL’s soundscape. First, we will take a look into REANIMAL’s monsters. To evoke a sense of uncanniness, familiarity and dread, we anchored the design of the creatures in the real world. We will discuss how raw, organic animal vocalizations were manipulated, layered, and processed to create monsters that sound eerie, yet believable and authentic. We will explore some of our creative fundaments as well as some of the technical execution too.

Moving from the biological to the mechanical, the presentation shifts to the game’s interactive vehicle and machine systems—such as the boat, the ice cream truck, the large fan, or the tumbler. We will discuss the more technological side of REANIMAL´s world, such as how we approached designing machines that feel desolate, broken and not tied to any specific time period.

We will break down the technical implementation under the hood, looking into how dynamic parameter modulation, real-time physics tracking, and game states are utilized to make these vehicles feel like believable,
sputtering, fragile machines barely holding together in the game´s hostile environment.

Finally, the presentation explores the topic of ambient world-building, focusing on the power of restraint and suspense. In our games, what you don’t hear is often just as vital as what you do. We will analyze how REANIMAL leverages suspense and minimalism to construct an oppressive, heavy atmosphere. We will look into how our ambient systems dynamically shift, using desolation as a structural tool to evoke a sense of abandonment and to contrast and amplify the game’s high-intensity, chaotic set pieces.

schedules.topic_zh: 从大模型到大世界：互动娱乐的新机遇
schedules.topic_en: From Large Models to Large Worlds: Reimagining Interactive Entertainment

speakers.title_zh: 美酷瑞创始人CEO
speakers.title_en: Founder & CEO at Gamercury AI
speakers.introduction_zh:
朱笑靖，美酷瑞创始人兼CEO，拥有近20年游戏与数字内容行业经验。曾任盛大游戏副总裁、分众游戏CEO，长期负责游戏研发、发行与商业化运营。职业生涯中主导打造《热血传奇手游版》《永恒之塔》《百万亚瑟王》《新网球王子》等多款知名产品，累计管理项目总营收超过200亿元人民币，在游戏研发、发行推广及全球化运营领域拥有丰富经验。

近年来，朱笑靖专注于人工智能与游戏产业融合创新，创办Gamercury AI，带领团队研发AI世界引擎及AI原生3D游戏《神探夏洛克：暗夜追踪者》，探索AI驱动的角色人格、情绪、记忆、叙事与动态世界生成技术在数字内容领域的创新应用。公司已完成多轮融资，入选微软AI加速器全球Top20、谷歌全球创业加速器等国际创新项目，并荣获腾讯游戏大赛AI技术大奖、数龙杯最佳视觉表达奖等荣誉。

演讲内容摘要：

生成式AI正在以前所未有的速度改变内容产业。但我们认为，真正的产业革命并非发生在内容制作阶段，而是即将发生在世界生成阶段。过去二十年，游戏产业的核心逻辑始终是“预设”。开发者设计剧情、配置数值、编写规则，玩家则在有限的选项中进行探索与选择，从本质上仍然是开发者创造内容，玩家消费内容。

而AI原生时代，正在打破这一底层逻辑。传统游戏依靠数值驱动，AI原生游戏依靠逻辑驱动；传统游戏提供选择，AI原生游戏追求理解；传统游戏创造内容，AI原生游戏生成世界。这不仅意味着技术升级，更意味着互动娱乐正在从“设计世界”走向“生成世界”，从“固定体验”走向“无限可能”。在AI原生游戏中，角色将拥有自己的记忆、情绪、目标与推理能力；剧情将不再按照预设分支展开，而是在玩家与AI的持续互动中实时生成；世界也将不再是一张地图，而是一个能够持续成长、自主运行、不断演化的智能生态系统。

如果说大模型解决的是“让AI学会思考”，那么大世界解决的则是“让世界学会成长”。在Gamercury AI，我们正在探索这一方向。通过AI世界引擎（AI World Engine），将人格系统、长期记忆系统、情绪系统、动态叙事系统以及世界状态模拟系统进行融合，构建从“角色智能”走向“世界智能”的下一代互动娱乐基础设施。

作为实践案例，Gamercury AI打造的AI原生3D游戏《神探夏洛克：暗夜追踪者》，首次尝试让玩家摆脱固定选项，通过自然语言与角色自由交流，通过推理影响事件发展，通过判断改变故事走向。在这里，玩家面对的不再是预设答案，而是真正需要被理解的世界。

产品在Gamescom、GDC等国际顶级游戏展期间获得开发者、发行商及媒体广泛关注，并在Steam Detective Fest中跻身全球前列，验证了全球玩家对于AI原生互动体验的强烈兴趣，也证明了世界生成正在成为互动娱乐的重要发展方向。

从大模型（Large Models）到大世界（Large Worlds），互动娱乐产业可能正在迎来继图形革命、网络革命和移动革命之后的新一轮范式转移。未来最具价值的产品，也许不再是一款游戏。未来最具价值的产品，将是一个能够记住你、理解你、陪伴你成长，并与你共同创造历史的世界。
speakers.introduction_en:
Michael Zhu is the Founder and CEO of Gamercury AI, with nearly 20 years of experience in the gaming and digital content industry. He previously served as Vice President of Shanda Games and CEO of Focus Media Games, leading game development, publishing, and commercialization initiatives. Throughout his career, he has played a key role in the success of several well-known titles, including Legend of Mir Mobile, Aion, Million Arthur, and The Prince of Tennis, overseeing projects that generated more than RMB 20 billion in cumulative revenue. He possesses extensive expertise in game development, publishing, marketing, and global operations.

In recent years, Michael has focused on the convergence of artificial intelligence and interactive entertainment. He founded Gamercury AI and leads the development of the AI World Engine and the AI-native 3D game Detective Sherlock: Shadow Stalker. His work explores the application of AI-driven character personalities, emotions, memory systems, narrative generation, and dynamic world simulation in digital content creation.

Under his leadership, Gamercury AI has secured multiple rounds of investment and has been selected for prestigious international innovation programs, including the Microsoft AI Accelerator Global Top 20 and Google for Startups Accelerator. The company has also received industry recognition, including the Tencent Game Competition AI Technology Award and the Dragon Cup Best Visual Expression Award.

 

Abstract：

Generative AI is transforming the content industry at an unprecedented pace. However, we believe the real industrial revolution will not take place at the stage of content creation, but at the stage of world generation.

For the past two decades, the core logic of the gaming industry has been based on predefined experiences. Developers design stories, configure game mechanics, and establish rules, while players explore and make choices within a limited set of options. At its core, the model has always been the same: developers create content, and players consume it.

The era of AI-native games is beginning to break this fundamental paradigm.

Traditional games are driven by numerical systems; AI-native games are driven by reasoning and logic. Traditional games provide choices; AI-native games pursue understanding. Traditional games create content; AI-native games generate worlds.

This shift represents far more than a technological upgrade. It marks a transformation from designed worlds to generated worlds, and from fixed experiences to limitless possibilities.

In AI-native games, characters will possess their own memories, emotions, goals, and reasoning capabilities. Storylines will no longer unfold through predefined branches, but will emerge dynamically through continuous interactions between players and AI. Worlds themselves will no longer be static maps, but living ecosystems capable of growth, adaptation, and evolution.

If Large Models enable AI to think, then Large Worlds enable worlds to grow.

At Gamercury AI, we are exploring this vision through our AI World Engine, which integrates personality systems, long-term memory, emotional intelligence, dynamic narrative generation, and world-state simulation into a unified framework. Our goal is to build the next-generation infrastructure for interactive entertainment, moving from character intelligence to world intelligence.

As a practical example, Gamercury AI developed the AI-native 3D game Detective Sherlock: Shadow Stalker, where players are no longer restricted to predefined dialogue options. Instead, they can communicate freely with characters through natural language, influence events through reasoning, and shape the story through their own decisions and deductions. In this world, players are not searching for predetermined answers—they are engaging with a world that understands them.

The game attracted significant attention from developers, publishers, and media during Gamescom and GDC, and achieved a leading position during Steam Detective Fest, demonstrating strong global demand for AI-native interactive experiences. These results suggest that world generation may become one of the most important directions for the future of interactive entertainment.

From Large Models to Large Worlds, the industry may be witnessing a new paradigm shift—one comparable to the graphics revolution, the internet revolution, and the mobile revolution.

In the future, the most valuable product may no longer be a game.

The most valuable product may be a world—one that remembers you, understands you, grows with you, and allows you to create history together.

The next question after teaching AI how to think is no longer how to generate more content.

It is how to bring worlds to life.

speakers.introduction_zh:
Ben Porter现领导全球领先的PC与主机游戏市场情报机构Newzoo的咨询业务，为全球顶级游戏发行商、开发商及投资机构提供市场规模评估、商业战略与资本配置建议，并将专有游戏数据转化为可执行洞察。他曾参与游戏行业多项投资与合作决策，包括上市、并购及大型IP投资的商业尽职调查。其研究涵盖品类经济学、玩家需求建模及商业化策略。Ben也是Game Developers Conference（GDC）的常邀演讲嘉宾，负责发布Newzoo年度《PC与主机游戏市场现状》报告。在加入Newzoo前，他曾在Aucerna从事八年咨询工作，为能源企业提供经济分析与投资组合优化建议。

演讲内容摘要：

Newzoo将带来最新的全球PC及主机游戏市场权威洞察，基于其独有的全球市场数据库和玩家调研成果，全面解析行业最新发展趋势。本次演讲由Newzoo咨询总监Ben Porter主讲，他将通过详实的数据分析，深入解读全球PC与主机游戏市场规模变化、平台格局演进、重点区域市场表现以及面向开发商、发行商和游戏平台的关键增长机会。

在40分钟的分享中，Ben还将结合2026年最新发布的数据，重点探讨1至2个当前最具关注度的行业热点议题，确保内容紧贴市场动态与行业实践。与会者将获得具有实际参考价值的市场洞察和趋势判断，帮助企业更好地制定商业战略、优化产品与变现规划、提升玩家运营与用户参与度，从而在快速变化的全球游戏市场中把握未来增长机遇。
speakers.introduction_en:
Ben Porter leads the consulting practice at Newzoo, the global benchmark for PC and console games market intelligence. He advises the world's largest game publishers, developers, and investors on market sizing, commercial strategy, and capital allocation, translating proprietary PC and console data into actionable insights. Porter has supported investment and partnership decisions across the games industry, including commercial due diligence for public listings, M&A, and major franchise investments. His work spans genre economics, player demand modeling, and monetization strategy for top-tier studios and platform holders globally. He is a recurring speaker at the Game Developers Conference (GDC), where he presents Newzoo's annual State of PC & Console Games report, and regularly presents to senior industry audiences globally. Prior to Newzoo, Porter spent eight years in consulting at Aucerna, advising energy companies on economic analysis and portfolio optimization.

Abstract:

Newzoo presents the definitive PC & console market update — built on exclusive global datasets and player research. Join Ben Porter, Director of Consulting, for a data-driven look at the latest market sizing, platform shifts, regional highlights, and key opportunities for developers, publishers, and platform holders. This 60-minute session will also explore 1–2 special topics based on fresh 2026 data, ensuring maximum relevance. Attendees will leave with actionable insights to inform business strategy, monetization planning, and player engagement in the year ahead.

speakers.title_zh: 隐藏关工作室制作人
speakers.title_en: Game Producer at Hidden Level
speakers.introduction_zh:
07年在厦门御风行做美术设计师，做《蜀山online》等项目，接着是极致游戏的艺术总监，做《道友请留步》等项目，后面兼做厦门异次元的艺术总监和厦门麻吉尔的创始人，做《元气幻灵师》和《小小朋来城》等项目。目前是新创厦门隐藏关游戏工作室。正在制作《莫娜：无尽的旅途》。

演讲内容摘要:

本次分享围绕《莫娜：无尽的旅途》展开，将完整拆解作品核心设计逻辑：首先追溯故事创作起源，梳理完整剧情脉络，解读选择黑暗幻想题材承载内核的创作初衷；其次讲解专属美术风格的打磨过程，剖析双主角设定的叙事与情感价值，说明全 3D 场景在沉浸感、空间探索上的设计优势；同时解析高操作门槛战斗系统的设计思路，阐释复杂操作与角色战力、游玩体验的适配逻辑。另外会介绍剧情融入游戏的多元呈现方式，包括主线、支线、场景彩蛋、道具叙事等融合手段，平衡叙事与玩法。最后展望作品后续内容更新、玩法优化与世界观拓展的长期规划，完整展示从故事、美术、玩法到长线运营的全套创作思考。
speakers.introduction_en:
I worked as an Art Designer at Xiamen Yufengxing in 2007, participating in projects including Shushan Online. Later, I served as Art Director at Woobest Games, where I developed titles such as Daoist, Stay A While.

After that, I took on dual roles as Art Director of Xiamen Yiciyuan and Founder of Xiamen Major-XL studio, creating games like Spirit Fantasy Master and Panland City .

Currently, I founded the newly established Xiamen Hidden Level Game Studio, and we are in production on Mona: The Endless Journey.

Abstract:

This presentation focuses on Mona: Endless Journey, fully analyzing the core design logic of the work. First, it traces the origin of the story, sorts out the complete plot, and explains why dark fantasy is chosen to carry the core theme. Next, it illustrates the polishing process of its exclusive art style, analyzes the narrative and emotional significance of the dual-protagonist setup, and clarifies the advantages of full 3D scenes in immersion and spatial exploration. It also interprets the design philosophy behind the skill-intensive combat system and how complex controls match character abilities and gameplay experience. Besides, it introduces diverse ways to integrate storytelling into gameplay, including main quests, side stories, environmental easter eggs and item texts to balance narrative and mechanics. In the end, it prospects long-term plans covering content updates, gameplay improvements and world expansion, presenting a full set of creative ideas ranging from plot, art and combat to long-term development.

speakers.introduction_zh:
姜磊是位于中国成都的游戏工作室91Act的创始人和游戏制作人。 主导创作了广受好评的<苍翼：混沌效应><电击文库：零境交错><苍翼之刃>等游戏作品。在创立91Act之前，姜磊还在腾讯，盛大等公司作为主创制作过<功夫小子>等游戏。

姜磊在动作游戏领域有着丰富的经验和众多成功的代表作，作品遍及手机、主机、PC等各种平台，并在中美日欧等全球主流市场中获得了千万级用户的认可。2024年发布的<苍翼：混沌效应>是姜磊极具强烈个人设计表达的游戏作品，获得了电击Indie大赏2024、NYX GAME AWARDS等诸多奖项。

演讲内容摘要：

《苍翼：混沌效应/X》历经PC(Windows/MacOS)，手机（iOS、Android、HarmonyOS），主机（Nintendo Switch 1/2、PlayStation、Xbox Series X|S），一路走来不断获得了持续的销量，也获得了更高的正向影响力。这是对所有中小团队都有参考价值的案例。
speakers.introduction_en:
Jiang Lei is the CEO and game producer of 91Act, a game studio based in Chengdu, China. He has led the creation of critically acclaimed titles including BlazBlue Entropy Effect 、Crossing void 、Blzeblue RR. Prior to founding 91Act, Jiang Lei also served as a lead creator at companies such as Tencent and Shanda, where he produced games including Kung Fu Kids.

With extensive experience in the action game genre and a strong portfolio of successful titles, Jiang Lei's work spans mobile, console, and PC platforms, earning tens of millions of players across major global markets including China, the United States, Japan, and Europe. Released in 2024, BlazBlue Entropy Effect is a game that reflects Jiang Lei's distinctive personal design vision, and has received numerous accolades including the Dengeki Indie Game Awards 2024 and the NYX Game Awards.

Abstract：

BlazBlue Entropy Effect / X has made its way across PC (Windows/macOS), mobile (iOS, Android, and HarmonyOS), and console (Nintendo Switch 1/2, PlayStation, and Xbox Series X|S), steadily building both sales momentum and a growing positive reputation along the way. This is a case study with real practical value for small and mid-sized teams everywhere.
